table.name: ACADEMIC_TERMS
table.purpose: Reference/dimension table of MIT academic terms (one row per term, 1995 through 2030). Each row describes a term (Fall, January/IAP, Spring, Summer) with its calendar dates, registration deadlines, and associated academic/financial-aid/degree years. It is the lookup for term codes used across course-offering, subject, library, and TIP tables.

ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.name: Term key
ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.description: Primary key; term code in the form YYYYTT (e.g. 2010JA = January term of academic year 2009-2010; FA=Fall, JA=January/IAP, SP=Spring, SU=Summer). Identical in value to TERM_CODE.

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: Academic year (ending year)
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Calendar year in which the academic year ends (e.g. 2010 for academic year 2009-2010). Four terms share each value.

ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC.name: Academic year description
ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC.description: Human-readable academic year label, e.g. 'Academic Year 2009-2010'.

ADD_DATE.name: Course add deadline
ADD_DATE.description: Last date to add a subject for the term (Oracle DD-MON-YY format). Null for about half the terms (mostly January terms and some others where no add deadline is recorded).

DEGREE_YEAR.name: Degree year
DEGREE_YEAR.description: Year in which degrees conferred for this term count; typically equals the following calendar year for spring/summer terms (e.g. 2023SU -> 2024) and the term's own year otherwise. Null for January terms.

DROP_DATE.name: Course drop deadline
DROP_DATE.description: Last date to drop a subject for the term (Oracle DD-MON-YY format). Null for about half the terms, same pattern as ADD_DATE.

FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.name: Financial aid year
FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.description: Financial-aid award year the term belongs to; values mirror DEGREE_YEAR (e.g. 2023SU -> 2024). Null for January terms.

FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.name: First day of classes
FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) on which classes begin for the term; e.g. 04-JAN-10 for 2010JA.

GRADUATE_AWARD_END_DATE.name: Graduate award end date
GRADUATE_AWARD_END_DATE.description: End date of the graduate student appointment/award period covering the term (e.g. 31-AUG-23 for 2023SU, 15-JAN for fall terms). Null for January terms.

GRADUATE_AWARD_START_DATE.name: Graduate award start date
GRADUATE_AWARD_START_DATE.description: Start date of the graduate student appointment/award period covering the term (e.g. 01-JUN-23 for 2023SU, 01-JUN or 01-SEP for fall terms). Null for January terms.

IS_CURRENT_TERM.name: Is current term flag
IS_CURRENT_TERM.description: Y/N flag marking the one term currently in session (exactly one row is 'Y').

IS_REGULAR_TERM.name: Is regular term flag
IS_REGULAR_TERM.description: Y/N flag distinguishing regular academic terms (Fall and Spring, 72 rows) from non-regular terms (January/IAP and Summer, 72 rows).

LAST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.name: Last day of classes
LAST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) on which classes end for the term.

LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM.name: Last day of final exams
LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last final exam of the term; equals or slightly follows the last day of classes.

PRE_REGISTRATION_START_DAY.name: Pre-registration start date
PRE_REGISTRATION_START_DAY.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) on which pre-registration for the term opens (e.g. 01-DEC-09 for 2010JA, 01-MAY-23 for 2023SU).

REGISTRATION_DAY.name: Registration day
REGISTRATION_DAY.description: Official registration day for the term (DD-MON-YY), typically the first day of classes or a few days before.

TERM_CODE.name: Term code
TERM_CODE.description: Canonical term code (YYYYTT: FA/SP/JA/SU suffix) used as foreign key by subject-offering, course-catalog, library, and TIP tables. Same value as ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.

TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: Term description
TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'January Term 2009-2010', 'Summer Term 2023'.

TERM_END_DATE.name: Term end date
TERM_END_DATE.description: Official end date of the term (DD-MON-YY), usually the last day of final exams.

TERM_SELECTOR.name: Term selector
TERM_SELECTOR.description: Concatenated display key 'TERM_CODE-TERM_DESCRIPTION' (e.g. '2010JA-January Term 2009-2010'), used for joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

TERM_START_DATE.name: Term start date
TERM_START_DATE.description: Official start date of the term (DD-MON-YY), typically the registration/first day of classes.

TERM_STATUS.name: Term status
TERM_STATUS.description: Relative status of the term: 'Previous' (past), 'Current' (in session), 'Future' (upcoming), or 'Unspecified' (mostly future terms without full data).

TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.name: Term status indicator
TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.description: Single-letter code for TERM_STATUS: C=Current, P=Previous, F=Future; null where status is 'Unspecified'.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows (full refresh).

table.name: ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL
table.purpose: Dimension/lookup table of all MIT academic terms (Fall, Spring, Summer, January) from 1951 through ~2030, one row per term, with calendar dates for term start/end, classes, exams, registration, and related academic-year, degree-year and financial-aid-year codes. It is the reference target for term codes used across the warehouse (subject offerings, course catalogs, student degree programs, time dimensions, etc.).

ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.name: Term key
ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.description: Primary key of the table; identical to TERM_CODE (e.g. '1953FA' = Fall 1953). Format: 4-digit year + term suffix FA/SP/SU (and JA for January).

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: Academic year (start year)
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Calendar year in which the academic year begins; e.g. term 1953FA belongs to academic year 1953 (i.e. 1952-1953). Each academic year has 4 terms (FA, SP, SU, JA).

ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC.name: Academic year description
ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC.description: Human-readable academic year label, e.g. 'Academic Year 1952-1953'.

DEGREE_YEAR.name: Degree year
DEGREE_YEAR.description: Year used for degree/conferral accounting for the term; for summer terms it is the following year (2016SU -> 2017). 'XXXX' is a placeholder for older terms where no degree year is assigned.

FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.name: Financial aid year
FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.description: Financial-aid award year associated with the term; matches DEGREE_YEAR (summer terms map to the following year, e.g. 2016SU -> 2017). 'XXXX' is a placeholder for older terms.

FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.name: First day of classes
FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the first day of classes for the term; null for older terms where it is not recorded.

GRADUATE_AWARD_END_DATE.name: Graduate award end date
GRADUATE_AWARD_END_DATE.description: End date of the graduate student award/fellowship appointment period covering the term (e.g. 31-AUG-16 for summer, 15-JAN for fall); null for many terms, especially older ones.

GRADUATE_AWARD_START_DATE.name: Graduate award start date
GRADUATE_AWARD_START_DATE.description: Start date of the graduate student award/fellowship appointment period covering the term (e.g. 01-JUN-16 for summer, 01-SEP for fall); null for many terms.

IS_CURRENT_TERM.name: Is current term flag
IS_CURRENT_TERM.description: Y/N flag marking the one term currently in progress; exactly one row has 'Y'.

LAST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.name: Last day of classes
LAST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.description: Date of the last day of classes for the term; null for older terms.

LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM.name: Last day of final exams
LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM.description: Date of the last final exam of the term; equals or slightly follows TERM_END_DATE.

PRE_REGISTRATION_START_DAY.name: Pre-registration start date
PRE_REGISTRATION_START_DAY.description: Date on which pre-registration opens for the term (typically 01-MAY for fall, early DEC for spring); null for older terms.

REGISTRATION_DAY.name: Registration day
REGISTRATION_DAY.description: Official registration day for the term, typically the same as or one day after TERM_START_DATE.

TERM_CODE.name: Term code
TERM_CODE.description: Canonical term code (4-digit year + FA/SP/SU/JA), primary key, referenced by term-code columns throughout the warehouse.

TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: Term description
TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'Fall Term 1952-1953', 'Summer Term 2016'.

TERM_END_DATE.name: Term end date
TERM_END_DATE.description: Official end date of the term (usually the last final-exam date), DD-MON-YY format.

TERM_SELECTOR.name: Term selector
TERM_SELECTOR.description: Concatenated code and description ('1953FA-Fall Term 1952-1953') used as a display selector in reports/UIs.

TERM_START_DATE.name: Term start date
TERM_START_DATE.description: Official start date of the term, DD-MON-YY format.

TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.name: Term status indicator
TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.description: Single-letter code for the term type/period: P = regular period (Fall/Spring/Summer), C = Fall Term 2024-2025, F = January Term 2024-2025 per the ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER lookup. The exact semantics of C vs P beyond those examples are not fully determined.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows in this snapshot.

table.name: ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER
table.purpose: SIS term-role lookup: maps each SIS term role (current, previous, upcoming) to a specific academic term with its dates. One row per term role; TERM_INDICATOR is the primary key (C=current, P=previous, F=future/upcoming). Denormalized copy of term attributes from ACADEMIC_TERMS/ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL keyed by role rather than by term code.

IS_CURRENT_TERM.name: is_current_term
IS_CURRENT_TERM.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this row's term is the current academic term; Y only on the row with TERM_PARAMETER = SIS_CURRENT_TERM.

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code in YYYY+session format (e.g. 2025FA = Fall 2025, 2024SU = Summer 2024, 2025JA = January/IAP 2025). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE and ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE.

TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: term_description
TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable name of the term, e.g. 'Fall Term 2024-2025', 'January Term 2024-2025', 'Summer Term 2024'.

TERM_END_DATE.name: term_end_date
TERM_END_DATE.description: Last day of the term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 20-DEC-24).

TERM_INDICATOR.name: term_status_indicator
TERM_INDICATOR.description: Primary key. Single-letter role code for the term relative to the present: C = current, P = previous, F = future/upcoming. Referenced by TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR in ACADEMIC_TERMS and ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

TERM_LAST_DAY_BEFORE_NEXT_TERM.name: term_last_day_before_next_term
TERM_LAST_DAY_BEFORE_NEXT_TERM.description: Last calendar day belonging to this term before the next term begins, DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 05-JAN-25 for Fall, 02-SEP-24 for Summer).

TERM_PARAMETER.name: term_parameter
TERM_PARAMETER.description: SIS parameter name identifying the term's role: SIS_CURRENT_TERM, SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM, or SIS_UPCOMING_TERM.

TERM_START_DATE.name: term_start_date
TERM_START_DATE.description: First day of the term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 03-SEP-24).

table.name: BUILDINGS
table.purpose: Campus building directory (MIT warehouse): one row per building with its number/key, name, street address, and gross and assignable square footage. Referenced by facility tables (FAC_ROOMS, FAC_FLOOR, FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS, FAC_BUILDING).

BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.name: assignable_square_footage
BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.description: Assignable (usable/occupiable) floor area of the building in square feet. Always less than or equal to gross square footage.

BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.name: gross_square_footage
BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.description: Total gross floor area of the building in square feet, including non-assignable space (walls, corridors, mechanical).

BUILDING_COUNTER.name: building_counter
BUILDING_COUNTER.description: Constant value 1 on every row; likely a dummy counter used for row counting/aggregation in queries rather than real data.

BUILDING_KEY.name: building_key
BUILDING_KEY.description: Primary key; building identifier code (e.g. 'W79', 'E52', 'NE47'), same value as BUILDING_NUMBER. Referenced by FAC_ROOMS, FAC_FLOOR, FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS, FAC_BUILDING.

BUILDING_NAME.name: building_name
BUILDING_NAME.description: Official building name (e.g. 'Simmons Hall', 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'); a few names repeat for related structures (e.g. Wallace Astrophysical Observatory).

BUILDING_NUMBER.name: building_number
BUILDING_NUMBER.description: Building number/code (e.g. 'W79', 'E52', '1'), identical to BUILDING_KEY; used as the join key to FAC_BUILDING, FCLT_BUILDING and as parent-building reference in those tables.

BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS.name: building_street_address
BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS.description: Street address of the building (number and street, no city/state), e.g. '229 VASSAR ST'. Multiple buildings can share an address.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date this row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a full refresh on that date.

table.name: CIP
table.purpose: NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) codes — the standard US taxonomy of academic program/major codes. Each row is one CIP program (6-digit) with its intermediate 4-digit and 2-digit category levels, the CIP revision version it belongs to, and change notes. Used as a lookup referenced by course/program tables (e.g., SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION).

CATEGORY_CODE.name: CIP 2-digit category code
CATEGORY_CODE.description: First two digits of the CIP code: the broad instructional category (e.g., 16 = Foreign Languages, 22 = Legal Professions, 43 = Homeland Security/Law Enforcement). The detected join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is a numeric coincidence, not a real relationship.

CATEGORY_TITLE.name: CIP 2-digit category title
CATEGORY_TITLE.description: Title of the broad CIP category, e.g., 'FOREIGN LANGUAGES AND LITERATURES', 'LEGAL PROFESSIONS AND STUDIES'. Duplicates arise because the same category appears across multiple CIP versions.

FOUR_DIGIT_CODE.name: CIP 4-digit intermediate code
FOUR_DIGIT_CODE.description: Middle two digits of the CIP code combined with the category, forming the 4-digit intermediate level of the CIP hierarchy (e.g., 1612 = Classical and Ancient Near Eastern Languages).

FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE.name: CIP 4-digit intermediate title
FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE.description: Title of the 4-digit CIP level, e.g., 'Criminal Justice and Corrections', 'Legal Research and Advanced Professional Studies'.

NOTE.name: CIP revision change note
NOTE.description: Notes describing changes between CIP revisions: new codes ('New in 2020'), no substantive changes, and code migrations ('Moved from 51.2931', 'Moved from 600401 to 612302'). Null where no note exists.

PROGRAM_CODE.name: CIP 6-digit program code
PROGRAM_CODE.description: Full 6-digit CIP program code (primary key), e.g., 161201 = Classics and Classical Languages. Referenced by SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE and CIP_WITH_VERSION.PROGRAM_CODE.

PROGRAM_TITLE.name: CIP 6-digit program title
PROGRAM_TITLE.description: Official title of the specific instructional program, e.g., 'Transportation Law', 'Financial Forensics and Fraud Investigation'. Slight duplicates come from repeated titles across CIP versions.

VERSION.name: CIP revision year
VERSION.description: CIP revision edition the row belongs to: 1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020. The table holds multiple revisions side by side (hence 3059 rows for ~582 4-digit codes).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (Oracle DD-MON-YY format). Two loads: 11-JUN-14 (1990/2000/2010 rows) and 17-MAY-23 (2020 rows).

table.name: CIP_WITH_VERSION
table.purpose: Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) codes across multiple CIP revision years (1990, 2000, 2010, 2020). Each row is one instructional program (6-digit CIP code) within a specific CIP version, with its 4-digit intermediate level and 2-digit category level titles. The table combines all four CIP editions, keyed by a composite of program code and version year.

CATEGORY_CODE.name: CIP 2-digit category code
CATEGORY_CODE.description: The 2-digit CIP category (top level of the CIP hierarchy), e.g. 12 = Personal and Miscellaneous Services, 43 = Protective Services, 51 = Health Professions. The detected join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is a coincidental numeric overlap, not a real relationship.

CATEGORY_TITLE.name: CIP category title
CATEGORY_TITLE.description: Title of the 2-digit CIP category, e.g. 'HEALTH PROFESSIONS AND RELATED PROGRAMS', 'EDUCATION'. Mixed casing reflects different CIP versions (older versions use uppercase).

CIP_WITH_VERSION_KEY.name: Primary key: program code + version year
CIP_WITH_VERSION_KEY.description: Surrogate/concatenated primary key formed by the 6-digit program code followed by the 4-digit version year (e.g. 120299 + 1990 = 1202991990). Uniquely identifies a program within a CIP revision.

FOUR_DIGIT_CODE.name: CIP 4-digit intermediate code
FOUR_DIGIT_CODE.description: The 4-digit middle level of the CIP hierarchy (program series), e.g. 1202 = Gaming and Sports Officiating Services, 4301 = Criminal Justice and Corrections.

FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE.name: CIP 4-digit series title
FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE.description: Title of the 4-digit CIP series, e.g. 'Teacher Education and Professional Development, Specific Subject Areas', 'Medical Residency Programs'. Mixed casing reflects different CIP versions.

PROGRAM_CODE.name: CIP 6-digit program code
PROGRAM_CODE.description: The 6-digit CIP program code identifying a specific instructional program, e.g. 120299, 430107. References CIP.PROGRAM_CODE; repeats across rows because the same program appears in multiple CIP versions.

PROGRAM_TITLE.name: CIP program title
PROGRAM_TITLE.description: Title of the 6-digit CIP program, e.g. 'Accounting', 'Veterinary Surgery', 'Community Awareness'. Titles vary across versions for the same code.

VERSION.name: CIP version year
VERSION.description: The CIP revision year the row belongs to: 1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, in DD-MON-YY format; each CIP version was loaded on a single date (e.g. 2020 version loaded 17-MAY-23).

table.name: CIS_COURSE_CATALOG
table.purpose: MIT course/subject catalog snapshot (from the CIS subject-maintained catalog), one row per subject per academic year (2002-2009), with title, description, units, grading, offering terms, instructors, and requirement attributes for each subject-year combination.

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: academic_year
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Academic year of the catalog snapshot (2002-2009), stored as a 4-digit string.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: communication_requirement_attribute
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for a Communication Intensive (CI) requirement attribute; only value observed is 'CIM' (Communication Intensive Major). Null for ~99% of subjects.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: communication_requirement_attribute_description
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE, e.g. 'Communication Intensive Major'.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Code of the MIT academic department owning the subject (e.g. '15' Management, '21F' Global Studies & Languages, 'CMS' Comparative Media Studies).

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the owning academic department, e.g. 'Management', 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'.

DESIGN_UNITS.name: design_units
DESIGN_UNITS.description: Number of design units credited by the subject (MIT unit breakdown: lecture/lab/preparation/design); 0 for almost all subjects.

EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.name: effective_term_code
EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.description: Term (e.g. 1997FA, 2007JA) from which this catalog version of the subject is effective; joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE.

FALL_INSTRUCTORS.name: fall_instructors
FALL_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor name(s) for the fall offering of the subject ('Staff' when unassigned); comma-separated for multiple instructors.

GRADE_RULE.name: grade_rule_code
GRADE_RULE.description: Code for the repeat/credit rule: R = repeatable for credit, N = not repeatable, J = continuing and repeatable, T = continuing.

GRADE_RULE_DESC.name: grade_rule_description
GRADE_RULE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GRADE_RULE, e.g. 'Can be repeated for credit'.

GRADE_TYPE.name: grade_type_code
GRADE_TYPE.description: Grading option code: L = letter graded, P = P/D/F (pass/no-record style) grading.

GRADE_TYPE_DESC.name: grade_type_description
GRADE_TYPE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GRADE_TYPE: 'Letter graded' or 'P/D/F'.

HGN_CODE.name: level_code
HGN_CODE.description: Subject level code: U = Undergraduate, G = Graduate, H = High Graduate (graduate-level subject open to advanced undergraduates).

HGN_DESC.name: level_description
HGN_DESC.description: Plain-text description of HGN_CODE (Undergraduate / Graduate / High Graduate).

IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.name: is_offered_fall_term
IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.description: Y/N flag indicating the subject is offered in the fall term.

IS_OFFERED_IAP.name: is_offered_iap
IS_OFFERED_IAP.description: Y/N flag indicating the subject is offered during Independent Activities Period (IAP, January).

IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.name: is_offered_spring_term
IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.description: Y/N flag indicating the subject is offered in the spring term.

IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.name: is_offered_summer_term
IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.description: Y/N flag indicating the subject is offered in the summer term.

IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.name: is_offered_this_year
IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.description: Y/N flag indicating the subject is offered at all during this academic year; null for ~7% of rows.

IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.name: is_printed_in_bulletin
IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.description: Y/N flag indicating the subject appears in the printed course bulletin/catalog.

IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.name: is_variable_units
IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.description: Y/N flag indicating the subject carries a variable (arrange-with-instructor) number of units.

LAB_UNITS.name: lab_units
LAB_UNITS.description: Number of lab units in the subject's unit breakdown; always 0 in this extract.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the subject record was last updated in the source system (Oracle DD-MON-YY format).

LECTURE_UNITS.name: lecture_units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Number of lecture (recitation/lecture) units in the subject's unit breakdown (0-6).

PREPARATION_UNITS.name: preparation_units
PREPARATION_UNITS.description: Number of preparation/outside-work units in the subject's unit breakdown (0-18).

PREREQUISITES.name: prerequisites
PREREQUISITES.description: Free-text prerequisite statement, e.g. '7.03, 7.05, 7.06' or 'Permission of instructor'.

PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.name: print_subject_id
PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID as printed in the bulletin; mostly equals SUBJECT_ID but can show ranges (e.g. '7.340–7.349') or blank.

SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.name: source_subject_id
SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID in the source system; essentially identical to SUBJECT_ID (e.g. '7.414', 'CMS.THU').

SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.name: spring_instructors
SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor name(s) for the spring offering of the subject; identical distribution to FALL_INSTRUCTORS suggests it may be copied rather than term-specific (tentative).

SUBJECT_CODE.name: subject_code
SUBJECT_CODE.description: Course code (department/subject prefix) of the subject, e.g. '21F', '15', 'CMS'; joins to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.name: subject_description
SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.description: Free-text catalog description of the subject; null for ~30% of rows.

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: Full subject identifier (course code + number, e.g. '21F.NIV', '11.951'); the natural key of the subject, repeated across academic years.

SUBJECT_NUMBER.name: subject_number
SUBJECT_NUMBER.description: The number part of the subject ID (e.g. 'NIV', '951', 'THU'), including special codes like UR (undergrad research), THG/THU (thesis).

SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.name: subject_short_title
SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.description: Abbreviated title of the subject, e.g. 'Visiting Student Research', 'CMS THESIS'.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: subject_title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Full title of the subject, e.g. 'Undergraduate Thesis in Comparative Media Studies'.

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.name: supervisor_attribute_code
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code flagging subjects requiring faculty supervision: UROP (undergraduate research), THG (graduate thesis), THU (undergraduate thesis); null otherwise.

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: supervisor_attribute_description
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE ('UROP subject', 'Grad Thesis', 'Undergrad Thesis').

TOTAL_UNITS.name: total_units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total MIT credit units for the subject (0-24); 0 for the ~63% of subjects with variable units.

TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.name: tuition_attribute_code
TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for special tuition treatment: RESH = pre-thesis research subject, NTRN = internship; null for most subjects.

TUITION_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: tuition_attribute_description
TUITION_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of TUITION_ATTRIBUTE ('Pre-thesis Research Subject', 'Internship').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this extract.

WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: writing_requirement_attribute
WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for a writing-requirement attribute; only observed value 'WRT2' (Writing Requirement, Phase II).

WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: writing_requirement_attribute_description
WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE, e.g. 'Writing Requirement, Phase II'.

table.name: CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE
table.purpose: Lookup table of MIT HASS (Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences) / GIR subject attribute codes, mapping each code to its bulletin description, form description, and display icon. Rows are grouped by whether the code applies to students entering Fall 2010 or later (HASS_ATTRIBUTE) or prior (GIR_ATTRIBUTE).

CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP.name: attribute_group_code
CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP.description: Group code indicating which requirement system the attribute belongs to: 'H' = HASS_ATTRIBUTE (students entering Fall 2010 or later), 'G' = GIR_ATTRIBUTE (students entering prior to Fall 2010).

CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP_NOTE.name: attribute_group_note
CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP_NOTE.description: Human-readable explanation of the group code: 'HASS_ATTRIBUTE, for students entering in Fall 2010 or later' or 'GIR_ATTRIBUTE, for students entering prior to Fall 2010'.

DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN.name: bulletin_description
DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN.description: How the attribute is displayed in the course bulletin, e.g. 'HASS-A', 'HASS-D 2', 'HASS-A, HASS-H'.

DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM.name: form_description
DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM.description: Plain-language description of the attribute as shown on forms, e.g. 'HASS Arts', 'HASS-D, Category 2', 'Arts + Humanities'.

HASS_ATTRIBUTE.name: hass_attribute_code
HASS_ATTRIBUTE.description: Compact code for the HASS/GIR attribute (HA=Arts, HH=Humanities, HS=Social Sciences, HE=Elective, HDn=HASS-D category n, with optional '2' suffix for half units). Joins to SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.

ICON_GIF_NAME.name: icon_file_name
ICON_GIF_NAME.description: Filename of the GIF icon used to display the attribute (e.g. hassS.gif, hassAH.gif). Null for attributes without an icon.

ICON_HEIGHT.name: icon_height_pixels
ICON_HEIGHT.description: Height of the icon in pixels; always 16 when present.

ICON_WIDTH.name: icon_width_pixels
ICON_WIDTH.description: Width of the icon in pixels: 16 for single-letter icons, 35 for two-letter combined icons (e.g. HASS-A + HASS-H). The detected join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (coincidental numeric match).

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the row was last modified, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. 05-MAR-10).

LAST_UPDATE_USER.name: last_update_user
LAST_UPDATE_USER.description: Username of the person who last updated the row (all rows: PETECHOI).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, in DD-MON-YY format (19-DEC-24 for all rows).

table.name: COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: MIT course catalog: one row per subject offering (subject + section, per term/year) with catalog attributes, units, instructors, meeting time/place, and requirement attributes. Appears to be a warehouse copy of SUBJECT_OFFERED enriched with catalog data (likely from the CIS course catalog).

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: academic_year
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Academic year of the offering, e.g. 2024 for the 2023-24 or 2024-25 year; 4-digit year string.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: communication_requirement_attribute_code
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for the Communication Intensive requirement attribute (CIM = Communication Intensive Major, CIH = HASS, CIHW = Writing); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: communication_requirement_attribute_description
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'Communication Intensive Major').

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: MIT department/course code owning the subject (e.g. 6 = EECS, 15 = Management, 21F = Foreign Languages).

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the department corresponding to DEPARTMENT_CODE (e.g. 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci').

DESIGN_UNITS.name: design_units
DESIGN_UNITS.description: Number of design (D) credit units for the subject; 0 for most subjects, up to 12. The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (numeric coincidence).

EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.name: effective_term_code
EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.description: Term (YYYY + FA/SP/SU/JA) in which this catalog version of the subject became effective; references ACADEMIC_TERMS.

EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.name: equivalent_subjects
EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.description: List of other subject numbers considered equivalent to this subject (comma-separated MIT subject IDs).

FALL_INSTRUCTORS.name: fall_instructors
FALL_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor name(s) for the fall offering of the subject; 'Staff' when unassigned.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE.name: gir_attribute_code
GIR_ATTRIBUTE.description: General Institute Requirement attribute code (HE = HASS Elective, REST, LAB, CAL2, PHY1, etc.); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: gir_attribute_description
GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GIR_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'HASS Elective', 'Institute Lab', 'Calculus II').

GLOBAL_COUNTRIES.name: global_countries
GLOBAL_COUNTRIES.description: Country or countries (pipe-separated) in which the subject is taught, for global/travel subjects; null for most.

GLOBAL_REGIONS.name: global_regions
GLOBAL_REGIONS.description: Region(s) (pipe-separated, e.g. 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Global (all regions)') for global/travel subjects.

GRADE_RULE.name: grade_rule_code
GRADE_RULE.description: Code for repeat-for-credit rule: N = not repeatable, R = repeatable, J = continuing and repeatable, T = continuing.

GRADE_RULE_DESC.name: grade_rule_description
GRADE_RULE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GRADE_RULE (e.g. 'Can be repeated for credit').

GRADE_TYPE.name: grade_type_code
GRADE_TYPE.description: Grading basis code: L = letter graded, P = pass/D/fail.

GRADE_TYPE_DESC.name: grade_type_description
GRADE_TYPE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GRADE_TYPE ('Letter graded' or 'P/D/F').

HASS_ATTRIBUTE.name: hass_attribute_code
HASS_ATTRIBUTE.description: HASS requirement category code(s): HA = Arts, HH = Humanities, HS = Social Sciences, HE = Elective; comma-separated when multiple; references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

HGN_CODE.name: level_code
HGN_CODE.description: Subject level code: U = Undergraduate, G = Graduate, H = High Graduate (graduate-level with undergraduate option).

HGN_EXCEPT.name: level_exception
HGN_EXCEPT.description: Exception clause to the H (high graduate) level rule, listing course numbers for which the subject is not counted as H (e.g. '(H except 18)').

IS_DESIGN_SECTION.name: is_design_section
IS_DESIGN_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a design section.

IS_LAB_SECTION.name: is_lab_section
IS_LAB_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a lab section.

IS_LECTURE_SECTION.name: is_lecture_section
IS_LECTURE_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a lecture section.

IS_MASTER_SECTION.name: is_master_section
IS_MASTER_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this row is the master (primary) section of the subject; '000' sections correspond to master rows.

IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.name: is_offered_fall_term
IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the fall term.

IS_OFFERED_IAP.name: is_offered_iap
IS_OFFERED_IAP.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered during Independent Activities Period (January).

IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.name: is_offered_spring_term
IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the spring term.

IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.name: is_offered_summer_term
IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the summer term.

IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.name: is_offered_this_year
IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the current academic year.

IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.name: is_printed_in_bulletin
IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.description: Y/N (one 'S' value) flag: subject description is printed in the course bulletin.

IS_RECITATION_SECTION.name: is_recitation_section
IS_RECITATION_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a recitation section.

IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.name: is_variable_units
IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.description: Y/N flag: subject carries a variable number of units (arranged with instructor).

JOINT_SUBJECTS.name: joint_subjects
JOINT_SUBJECTS.description: List of subject numbers with which this subject is jointly offered (the 'J' cross-listings, comma-separated).

LAB_UNITS.name: lab_units
LAB_UNITS.description: Number of lab (L) credit units per week for the subject; 0 for most. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date of last catalog update/activity for this subject record (Oracle-style DD-MON-YY format).

LECTURE_UNITS.name: lecture_units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Number of lecture (lecture/recitation) credit units per week; typically 0-5, up to 9. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID of the master subject this section/subject belongs to (e.g. the parent number for cross-listed or numbered variants); null for master rows.

MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.name: meets_with_subjects
MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.description: List of subject numbers whose classes this subject meets with (shared classroom/time), comma-separated.

MEET_PLACE.name: meeting_place
MEET_PLACE.description: Classroom location for the section (building-room, e.g. 'E51-350', or 'VIRTUAL').

MEET_TIME.name: meeting_time
MEET_TIME.description: Meeting time pattern, e.g. 'TR11-12.30' (Tue/Thu 11:00-12:30), 'MW1-2.30', '*TO BE ARRANGED'.

ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.name: online_catalog_url
ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.description: URL of the online catalog page where this subject's description appears (student.mit.edu catalog page).

PREPARATION_UNITS.name: preparation_units
PREPARATION_UNITS.description: Number of preparation/home-study (P) credit units per week; typically 0-9, up to 18. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

PREREQUISITES.name: prerequisites
PREREQUISITES.description: Prerequisite text: subject numbers, GIR codes (e.g. GIR:CAL1), and/or 'permission of instructor'.

PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.name: print_subject_id
PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID as printed in the catalog (may include 'J' suffix for joint subjects); display form of the subject number.

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.name: responsible_faculty_mit_id
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.description: MIT ID number of the faculty member responsible for the subject.

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.name: responsible_faculty_name
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.description: Name of the responsible faculty member ('Last, First' format).

SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.name: school_wide_electives
SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.description: List of subject numbers that together form a school-wide elective group (e.g. the .EPE/.EPW engineering practice series) to which this subject belongs.

SECTION_ID.name: section_id
SECTION_ID.description: Section identifier: '000' for the master/subject-level row, L## lecture, R## recitation, B## lab/design sections.

SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.name: source_subject_id
SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID in the source system for this row; for cross-listed subjects may differ from the master number.

SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.name: spring_instructors
SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor name(s) for the spring offering of the subject; 'Staff' when unassigned.

STATUS_CHANGE.name: status_change
STATUS_CHANGE.description: Catalog status change note for the subject: new subject, removed subject, renumbering history (e.g. 'New subject', '(2012: Removed subject)', 'Old number: 6.7201').

SUBJECT_CODE.name: subject_code
SUBJECT_CODE.description: Course/subject code prefix (department number, e.g. '6', '21F', 'CSB'); references SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.name: subject_description
SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.description: Full catalog description text of the subject.

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: MIT subject number (course.number, e.g. '6.011', '21G.152'); key identifying the subject.

SUBJECT_NUMBER.name: subject_number
SUBJECT_NUMBER.description: The number part of the subject ID after the course code (e.g. '011', 'THG' for thesis).

SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.name: subject_short_title
SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.description: Abbreviated title of the subject as shown in schedules.

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.name: supervisor_attribute_code
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for supervisor-approval subject type: UROP, INDP (independent study), THG (graduate thesis), THU (undergraduate thesis).

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: supervisor_attribute_description
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'UROP subject', 'Grad Thesis').

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term of the offering (YYYY + FA/SP/SU/JA); references ACADEMIC_TERMS. Null for master/subject-level rows.

TERM_DURATION.name: term_duration
TERM_DURATION.description: Portion of the term the subject runs: Full Term, First Half, Second Half, or Partial Term Subject.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: total_units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total credit units for the subject (lecture + lab + preparation); 12 is the standard full subject. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.name: tuition_attribute_code
TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.description: Special tuition-related attribute code: RESH (pre-thesis research subject), NTRN (internship), COOP (co-op); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (constant '19-DEC-24' in this extract).

WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: writing_requirement_attribute_code
WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Writing requirement attribute code: WRT1 (Phase I) or WRT2 (Phase II); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: writing_requirement_attribute_description
WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE (Writing Requirement Phase I/II).

table.name: DRUPAL_COURSE_CATALOG
table.purpose: MIT subject (course) catalog snapshot exported for the Drupal course catalog website. One row per subject per term offering, with title, description, units, instructors, meeting time/place, grading, and requirement attributes (GIR, HASS, CI, etc.). Data mirrors the MIT course bulletin / subject offering records (cf. SUBJECT_OFFERED, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG).

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: Academic year
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Academic year of the offering, e.g. 2011 for the 2010-2011 year (matches SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION 'Spring Term 2010-2011').

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: Communication Intensive attribute code
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for the Communication Intensive requirement attribute: CIM = Communication Intensive Major, CIH = Communication Intensive HASS. References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: Communication Intensive attribute description
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'Communication Intensive Major').

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: Course/department number
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: MIT course (department) number, e.g. 1 = Civil and Environmental Engineering, 2 = Mechanical Engineering, 9 = Brain and Cognitive Sciences. The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the MIT department owning the subject (abbreviated, e.g. 'Civil and Environmental Eng').

DESIGN_UNITS.name: Design units
DESIGN_UNITS.description: Number of units counted as design (part of MIT's units breakdown: lecture+lab+prep+design). Mostly 0; up to 12. The SPACE_USAGE join is spurious.

EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.name: Effective term code
EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.description: Term code (e.g. 2016FA, 2007JA) from which this catalog entry is effective; references ACADEMIC_TERMS/ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.name: Equivalent subjects
EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.description: Comma-separated list of other subject numbers considered equivalent to this subject (e.g. '8.022, 8.02X').

FALL_INSTRUCTORS.name: Fall term instructors
FALL_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor names for the fall offering, comma-separated; 'Staff' when unassigned.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE.name: General Institute Requirement attribute code
GIR_ATTRIBUTE.description: GIR attribute code: REST (Rest Elec in Sci & Tech), LAB (Institute Lab), LAB2 (half lab), HE (HASS Elective), PHY1/PHY2 (Physics I/II), HD1/HD2 (Calculus etc.). References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: GIR attribute description
GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GIR_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'Institute Lab', 'Physics I').

GLOBAL_REGIONS.name: Global regions flag
GLOBAL_REGIONS.description: Constant 'Global (all regions)' on the single non-null row; likely a scope marker for a global/MITx version of the catalog. Little evidence.

GRADE_RULE.name: Grade rule code
GRADE_RULE.description: Whether the subject may be repeated for credit: N = not repeatable, R = repeatable, J = continuing and repeatable, T = continuing.

GRADE_TYPE.name: Grade type code
GRADE_TYPE.description: L = letter graded, P = P/D/F (pass/no-record style) grading option.

HASS_ATTRIBUTE.name: HASS attribute code
HASS_ATTRIBUTE.description: HASS requirement category: HS = HASS Social Sciences, HH = HASS Humanities, HE = HASS Elective. References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

HGN_CODE.name: Level code (H/G/N)
HGN_CODE.description: Subject level: U = Undergraduate, G = Graduate, H = High Graduate (graduate-level subject open to advanced undergraduates).

HGN_EXCEPT.name: Level exception note
HGN_EXCEPT.description: Footnote to the level code, e.g. '(H except 1, 18)' meaning H level except for certain course numbers. Only one non-null value.

IS_DESIGN_SECTION.name: Design-section flags per section
IS_DESIGN_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags, one per section of the subject, indicating whether each section is a design section.

IS_LAB_SECTION.name: Lab-section flags per section
IS_LAB_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags, one per section, indicating whether each section is a lab section.

IS_LECTURE_SECTION.name: Lecture-section flags per section
IS_LECTURE_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags, one per section, indicating whether each section is a lecture section.

IS_MASTER_SECTION.name: Master-section flags per section
IS_MASTER_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags, one per section, indicating whether each section is the master/parent section of the subject.

IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.name: Offered in fall term
IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the fall term.

IS_OFFERED_IAP.name: Offered in IAP
IS_OFFERED_IAP.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered during Independent Activities Period (January).

IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.name: Offered in spring term
IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the spring term.

IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.name: Offered in summer term
IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the summer term.

IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.name: Offered this year
IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered at all during the current academic year.

IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.name: Printed in bulletin
IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.description: Y/N flag: subject appears in the printed course bulletin/catalog.

IS_RECITATION_SECTION.name: Recitation-section flags per section
IS_RECITATION_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags, one per section, indicating whether each section is a recitation section.

IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.name: Variable units flag
IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.description: Y/N flag: the subject carries a variable number of units (arranged with instructor).

JOINT_SUBJECTS.name: Joint subjects
JOINT_SUBJECTS.description: Comma-separated list of subject numbers with which this subject is jointly listed (the 'J' cross-listings, e.g. '2.689J').

LAB_UNITS.name: Lab units
LAB_UNITS.description: Weekly laboratory units in the MIT units breakdown (lecture-lab-prep). SPACE_USAGE join is spurious.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: Last activity date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the subject record was last updated/changed (Oracle-style DD-MON-YY format).

LECTURE_UNITS.name: Lecture units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Weekly lecture units in the MIT units breakdown. SPACE_USAGE join is spurious.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Master subject ID
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject number of the master/parent subject when this row is a joint or cross-listed child (e.g. 9.22J's master is 9.22); null for standalone subjects.

MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.name: Meets-with subjects
MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.description: Comma-separated list of other subject numbers whose sections meet together with this subject.

MEET_PLACE.name: Meeting place
MEET_PLACE.description: Classroom location(s) per section, MIT building-room format (e.g. '5-267E'); 'VIRTUAL' for online; comma-separated per section.

MEET_TIME.name: Meeting time
MEET_TIME.description: Meeting schedule per section, e.g. 'TR9.30-11' (Tue/Thu 9:30-11); comma-separated per section, sometimes with free-text notes.

ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.name: Online catalog page URL
ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.description: URL of the online catalog page (student.mit.edu/catalog) where the subject is listed; null when not in the online catalog.

PREPARATION_UNITS.name: Preparation units
PREPARATION_UNITS.description: Weekly preparation/home-work units in the MIT units breakdown. SPACE_USAGE join is spurious.

PREREQUISITES.name: Prerequisites
PREREQUISITES.description: Prerequisite text: subject numbers, GIR codes (e.g. 'GIR:BIOL'), or 'Permission of instructor'.

PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.name: Print subject ID
PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject number as printed in the bulletin, including the 'J' suffix for joint subjects (e.g. '9.22J').

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.name: Responsible faculty MIT IDs
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.description: MIT ID number(s) of the responsible faculty/instructor of record, comma-separated and repeated per section.

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.name: Responsible faculty names
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.description: Name(s) of the responsible faculty, 'Last, First' format, comma-separated and repeated per section.

SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.name: School-wide electives list
SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.description: Comma-separated list of subject numbers that satisfy a school-wide elective requirement this subject belongs to (e.g. engineering school-wide electives lists).

SECTION_ID.name: Section IDs
SECTION_ID.description: Comma-separated section identifiers for the subject's sections, e.g. 'L01,000' (lecture 01, master 000), 'R01' recitation, 'B01' lab.

SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.name: Source subject ID
SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject number without the 'J' suffix (the home/source subject, e.g. '9.22' for '9.22J').

SO_CLUSTER_TYPE.name: Subject offering cluster type
SO_CLUSTER_TYPE.description: Type of the subject within a joint/meets-with cluster: J = joint subject, M = master/parent, S = (likely) meets-with or secondary member. S meaning is inferred, not certain.

SO_SUBJECT_ID.name: Subject offering subject ID
SO_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject number of the subject offering record (same domain as SUBJECT_ID; the SO_ prefix ties to SUBJECT_OFFERED).

SO_TERM_CODE.name: Subject offering term code
SO_TERM_CODE.description: Term code of the offering (e.g. 2011SP); references ACADEMIC_TERMS/ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: Subject offering term description
SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'Spring Term 2010-2011', 'January Term 2008-2009'.

SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.name: Spring term instructors
SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor names for the spring offering, comma-separated; 'Staff' when unassigned.

STATUS_CHANGE.name: Status change note
STATUS_CHANGE.description: Bulletin note about the subject's status change: new subject, reinstated, removed, renumbered (e.g. 'Old number: 13.024', '(2012: New number: 9.S97)').

SUBJECT_CODE.name: Subject course number
SUBJECT_CODE.description: Same as DEPARTMENT_CODE: the MIT course number prefix of the subject (1-9). SPACE_USAGE join is spurious.

SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.name: Subject description
SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.description: Full catalog description of the subject.

SUBJECT_NUMBER.name: Subject number
SUBJECT_NUMBER.description: The part of the subject number after the course prefix (e.g. '22' for 2.22, 'UR' for undergraduate research).

SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.name: Subject short title
SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.description: Abbreviated title used in schedules/bulletin (e.g. 'Des Principles: Ocean Vehicles').

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: Subject title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Full title of the subject (e.g. 'Design Principles for Ocean Vehicles').

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.name: Supervisor attribute code
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.description: Attribute for supervised-study subjects: UROP = UROP subject, INDP = Independent Study. References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

TERM_DURATION.name: Term duration
TERM_DURATION.description: Whether the subject runs the full term, first half, second half, or partial term.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: Total units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total MIT credit units for the subject (lecture+lab+prep+design; typical 12). SPACE_USAGE join is spurious.

TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.name: Tuition attribute code
TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.description: Special tuition-related attribute: RESH = pre-thesis research subject, NTRN = internship, COOP = co-op subject. References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of this snapshot into the warehouse (constant '19-DEC-24').

table.name: DRUPAL_EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY
table.purpose: Employee directory snapshot (one row per employee, keyed by MIT_ID) published for the Drupal web directory. Contains name, email, employment classification, HR org unit, office location and phone. Appears to be a Drupal-facing copy of EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY, loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24. Data appears anonymized/synthetic (emails at worker.com, scrambled phone numbers).

EMAIL_ADDRESS.name: EMAIL_ADDRESS
EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Employee's email address (anonymized to worker.com addresses). Not unique — shared addresses suggest placeholder/anonymized data.

EMPLOYEE_GROUP.name: EMPLOYEE_GROUP
EMPLOYEE_GROUP.description: HR employee group classification: Exempt, Non-Exempt (FLSA overtime-exemption status), or External (non-employee/affiliate).

EMPLOYEE_TYPE.name: EMPLOYEE_TYPE
EMPLOYEE_TYPE.description: HR employee type / job category, e.g. Admin Staff, Support Staff, Service Staff, Sponsored Research Staff, Faculty, Affiliate, Other Academic Group.

FULL_NAME.name: FULL_NAME
FULL_NAME.description: Employee's full display name in 'Last, First [Middle/Initial]' format.

HAS_ADDL_APPOINTMENT.name: HAS_ADDL_APPOINTMENT
HAS_ADDL_APPOINTMENT.description: Y/N flag indicating the person holds an additional (secondary) appointment beyond their primary one.

HAS_DUAL_APPOINTMENT.name: HAS_DUAL_APPOINTMENT
HAS_DUAL_APPOINTMENT.description: Y/N flag indicating the person holds a dual appointment (e.g. across two departments).

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: HR_ORG_UNIT_ID
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: Foreign key to HR_ORG_UNIT (also HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW) identifying the employee's HR organizational unit (department).

HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE.name: HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE.description: Name of the employee's HR organizational unit (e.g. 'Mechanical Engineering', 'MIT Health'); denormalized from HR_ORG_UNIT.

MIDDLE_NAME.name: MIDDLE_NAME
MIDDLE_NAME.description: Employee's middle name or initial; null for about half the rows.

MIT_ID.name: MIT_ID
MIT_ID.description: Primary key: the person's MIT ID number (9-digit identifier, here anonymized). Uniquely identifies one row per employee.

OFFICE_LOCATION.name: OFFICE_LOCATION
OFFICE_LOCATION.description: Office location as an MIT building-room code (e.g. 'NE49', 'E15-293', '37-267F'); building number optionally followed by room.

OFFICE_PHONE.name: OFFICE_PHONE
OFFICE_PHONE.description: Office phone number, stored as digits (leading 1s suggest full 10/11-digit numbers). Values appear anonymized/scrambled, so exact format is tentative.

PERSONAL_URL.name: PERSONAL_URL
PERSONAL_URL.description: Employee's personal web page URL; essentially unpopulated (only 5 non-null placeholder values in this snapshot).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot (Oracle DD-MON-YY format).

table.name: EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY
table.purpose: MIT employee/staff directory: one row per employee, with names, department, contact info, office location, and MIT ID. Data appears anonymized/synthetic (fake emails, names, phone numbers).

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the employee's MIT department or lab (e.g., Lincoln Laboratory, Sloan School of Management).

DEPARTMENT_NUMBER.name: department_number
DEPARTMENT_NUMBER.description: Numeric code identifying the employee's department (e.g., 310000 = Lincoln Laboratory, 121000 = Sloan).

DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME.name: directory_full_name
DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME.description: Employee's full name as displayed in the directory, in 'Last, First M.' format; identical to FULL_NAME.

EMAIL_ADDRESS.name: email_address
EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Employee's email address (anonymized/synthetic values, e.g., callanr@worker.com).

EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE.name: email_address_uppercase
EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE.description: Same as EMAIL_ADDRESS in uppercase, for case-insensitive matching.

FULL_NAME.name: full_name
FULL_NAME.description: Employee's full name in 'Last, First M.' format.

FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE.name: full_name_uppercase
FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE.description: Same as FULL_NAME in uppercase, for case-insensitive matching.

KRB_NAME.name: kerberos_username
KRB_NAME.description: MIT Athena/Kerberos account username (typically firstname+lastname-initial); used for authentication and email aliasing.

KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE.name: kerberos_username_uppercase
KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE.description: Same as KRB_NAME in uppercase, for case-insensitive matching.

MIDDLE_NAME.name: middle_name
MIDDLE_NAME.description: Employee's middle name or middle initial; null for about a third of employees.

MIT_ID.name: mit_id
MIT_ID.description: Unique 9-digit MIT identification number for the employee; primary key of the table.

NAME_KNOWN_BY.name: name_known_by
NAME_KNOWN_BY.description: The name the person is known by (informal/preferred display name); values match FIRST_NAME/PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME.

OFFICE_LOCATION.name: office_location
OFFICE_LOCATION.description: MIT building-room office location code (e.g., '8-479' = building 8 room 479; 'LL-...' = Lincoln Laboratory).

OFFICE_PHONE.name: office_phone
OFFICE_PHONE.description: Office phone number (stored as digits; synthetic values, so exact format/area code meaning unverifiable).

PERSONAL_URL.name: personal_url
PERSONAL_URL.description: Employee's personal website URL; null for ~86% of rows.

PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME.name: preferred_first_name
PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME.description: First name the employee prefers to be called; currently identical to FIRST_NAME.

PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME_UPPER.name: preferred_first_name_upper
PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME_UPPER.description: PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME in uppercase, for case-insensitive matching.

PREFERRED_LAST_NAME.name: preferred_last_name
PREFERRED_LAST_NAME.description: Last name the employee prefers; currently identical to LAST_NAME.

PREFERRED_LAST_NAME_UPPER.name: preferred_last_name_upper
PREFERRED_LAST_NAME_UPPER.description: PREFERRED_LAST_NAME in uppercase, for case-insensitive matching.

PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME.name: preferred_middle_name
PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME.description: Middle name/initial the employee prefers; null for ~69% of rows.

table.name: ESTIMATED_SURCHARGES_ESTONLY
table.purpose: Table is empty (0 rows), so no data evidence exists. Column names suggest a financial/budget fact table about estimated surcharges with cost-collector, GL account, and time dimensions, but this cannot be confirmed from data.

table.name: FAC_BUILDING
table.purpose: Facilities building inventory: one row per MIT building (242 buildings), with attributes such as name, type, use, areas, room counts, location coordinates, ownership, dates, and parent-building relationships. Referenced by floor, room, and address tables via building key/number.

ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE.name: Access level code
ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE.description: Numeric code for the building's access level; values 0, 1, 2 (2 most common, ~76%). Exact meaning of each level is not documented here; likely relates to campus access/security classification.

ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME.name: Access level name
ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME.description: Stored as text but contains only the digits 0, 1, 2, identical to ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE; appears to be a mislabeled duplicate of the code column rather than a real name.

ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Assignable area (sq ft)
ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Assignable floor area of the building in square feet (sum of rooms assignable to occupants), 0 to ~285,682.

BUILDING_HEIGHT.name: Building height (ft)
BUILDING_HEIGHT.description: Height of the building, likely in feet (values 0 to 275; 0 or null for many rows, e.g. leased or unbuilt properties).

BUILDING_NAME.name: Building name (short/uppercase)
BUILDING_NAME.description: Official short building name in uppercase, e.g. 'COGENERATION PLANT', 'MIT ALUMNI POOL'.

BUILDING_NAMED_FOR.name: Person(s) building is named for
BUILDING_NAMED_FOR.description: Person or people the building is named after ('-' when not named for someone), e.g. 'CHARLES HAYDEN', 'ALFRED P. SLOAN JR.'.

BUILDING_NAME_LONG.name: Building long name
BUILDING_NAME_LONG.description: Longer/mixed-case building name, e.g. 'William R. Dickson Cogeneration Plant', 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'.

BUILDING_NUMBER.name: Building number
BUILDING_NUMBER.description: MIT building number/code, unique per row (e.g. '42', 'E66', 'W85A', 'OC19Q'); primary identifier referenced by address, floor, room, and history tables.

BUILDING_SORT.name: Building sort key
BUILDING_SORT.description: Zero-padded/normalized version of the building number used for sorting (e.g. '01', '02'); matches BUILDING_NUMBER one-to-one.

BUILDING_TYPE.name: Building type
BUILDING_TYPE.description: Broad building category: ACADEMIC (126), SERVICE (59), or RESIDENT (57).

BUILDING_USE.name: Building use code
BUILDING_USE.description: Use classification code: AER (academic/research, 124), DHOA (dormitory/house, 54), OTH (other, 32), STAC (student activities/athletics, 17), GAR (garage/parking), plus '(NULL)' placeholder for 8 rows. Exact code definitions are inferred from context, not documented.

CAMPUS_SECTOR.name: Campus sector
CAMPUS_SECTOR.description: Campus region the building sits in: WEST, MAIN GROUP, OFFCAMPUS, EAST, NORTHWEST, NORTHEAST, etc. (note 'WESTWEST' appears, likely a data quirk).

COST_CENTER_CODE.name: Cost center code
COST_CENTER_CODE.description: SAP-style cost center number (7-digit, e.g. 1814200) for the building's financial accounting; null for ~46% of buildings (leased/unassigned).

COST_COLLECTOR_KEY.name: Cost collector key
COST_COLLECTOR_KEY.description: Identical values to COST_CENTER_CODE in every statistic and sample; appears to be a duplicate of the cost center code.

DATE_ACQUIRED.name: Date acquired
DATE_ACQUIRED.description: Date MIT acquired the building (MM/DD/YYYY), mostly null (owned long ago or not applicable); populated for leased/acquired properties.

DATE_BUILT.name: Date built
DATE_BUILT.description: Construction date of the building (MM/DD/YYYY), null for ~38% of rows.

DATE_OCCUPIED.name: Date occupied
DATE_OCCUPIED.description: Date the building was first occupied (MM/DD/YYYY); often shortly after DATE_BUILT.

EASTING_X_SPCS.name: Easting coordinate (SPCS)
EASTING_X_SPCS.description: Easting (X) coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System (likely Massachusetts Mainland, US survey feet), ~657,854-796,445; null for off-campus/leased sites.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: External gross area (sq ft)
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: External gross floor area of the building in square feet, 0 to ~466,722.

FAC_BUILDING_KEY.name: Facilities building key
FAC_BUILDING_KEY.description: Primary key of the table; same value as BUILDING_NUMBER (e.g. '42', 'E66'). Referenced by FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS, FAC_FLOOR, FAC_ROOMS and the FCLT_* tables.

LATITUDE_WGS.name: Latitude (WGS84)
LATITUDE_WGS.description: WGS84 latitude of the building, ~42.25-42.62 (Cambridge, MA area); null for ~43% of rows.

LONGITUDE_WGS.name: Longitude (WGS84)
LONGITUDE_WGS.description: WGS84 longitude of the building, ~-71.49 to -70.98 (eastern Massachusetts); null for ~43% of rows.

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Non-assignable area (sq ft)
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area (corridors, mechanical, restrooms, etc.) in square feet, 0 to ~151,963.

NORTHING_Y_SPCS.name: Northing coordinate (SPCS)
NORTHING_Y_SPCS.description: Northing (Y) coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System, ~2,917,720-3,052,190; null for off-campus/leased sites.

NUM_OF_ROOMS.name: Number of rooms
NUM_OF_ROOMS.description: Count of rooms in the building, 0 to 1,424.

OCCUPANCY_CLASS.name: Occupancy class code
OCCUPANCY_CLASS.description: Building/fire-code occupancy classification (UG-prefixed codes, e.g. UGB, UGR2, UGA3, UGF1; '(NULL)' placeholder for 98 rows). Exact code meanings not documented here.

OWNERSHIP_TYPE.name: Ownership type
OWNERSHIP_TYPE.description: Whether the building is OWNED (220) or LEASED (22) by MIT.

PARENT_BUILDING_NAME.name: Parent building name
PARENT_BUILDING_NAME.description: Uppercase name of the parent building for sub-buildings/annexes (e.g. 'MACGREGOR HOUSE'); null for ~87% of rows (standalone buildings).

PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG.name: Parent building long name
PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG.description: Long/mixed-case name of the parent building, e.g. 'Frank S MacGregor House'; null for standalone buildings.

PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER.name: Parent building number
PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER.description: Building number of the parent building (references BUILDING_NUMBER), e.g. 'W61', '14'; null for standalone buildings.

SITE.name: Site code
SITE.description: Site/location code: MIT (main campus, 198), BATES (Bates Linear Accelerator, 14), HAY (Haystack Observatory, 12), LINC (Lincoln Laboratory, 9), BOS (Boston), END (Endicott House), etc.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a full snapshot load.

table.name: FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS
table.purpose: One row per building address, holding multiple address types (street, mailing, E911, parcel) per MIT facility building. Part of the facilities (FAC) space data set; the FCLT_ tables appear to be a related/historical copy of the same data.

ADDRESS_CITY_ID.name: address_city_id
ADDRESS_CITY_ID.description: Numeric identifier for the address assigned by the city/municipality (e.g., Cambridge GIS/E911 address ID). Not a join key in this database; exact issuing system unresolved.

ADDRESS_PURPOSE.name: address_purpose
ADDRESS_PURPOSE.description: Type of address record: STREET (official street address), MAIL (mailing address), E911_1..E911_6 (emergency-911 registered addresses, multiple per building), PARCL1/PARCL2 (parcel/tax-parcel addresses).

BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY.name: building_address_key
BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY.description: Primary key: composite of building key and address purpose (e.g., 'N16-E911_1'). Referenced by the history table FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_HIST.

BUILDING_KEY.name: building_key
BUILDING_KEY.description: Foreign key to FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING / BUILDINGS identifying the building (MIT building number such as W70, N16, 2).

CITY.name: city
CITY.description: City of the address (mostly Cambridge, MA; also Lexington, Westford, Middleton, Boston, Washington DC, etc. for off-campus sites).

POSTAL_CODE.name: postal_code
POSTAL_CODE.description: US ZIP code stored without leading zero (2139 = 02139 Cambridge, 2142 = 02142, 20002 = Washington DC).

POST_DIRECTIONAL.name: post_directional
POST_DIRECTIONAL.description: Directional or qualifier appearing after the street name (NE, NW, '(Rear)' for rear entrances).

STATE.name: state
STATE.description: Two-letter state code of the address (MA, DC).

STREET_NAME.name: street_name
STREET_NAME.description: Street name of the address (Massachusetts Ave, Memorial Drive, Vassar Street, Albany Street, etc.).

STREET_NUMBER.name: street_number
STREET_NUMBER.description: House/street number; some values are internal facility codes like 'MEM106'/'MEM311' (Memorial Drive room/entrance numbering) rather than civic numbers.

STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX.name: street_number_suffix
STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX.description: Suffix appended to the street number; only value observed is 'R' (rear address).

STREET_SUFFIX.name: street_suffix
STREET_SUFFIX.description: Street type abbreviation: ST, AVE, DR, RD, SQ, CIR, etc.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant 19-DEC-24 for this extract.

table.name: FAC_FLOOR
table.purpose: Facilities floor-level space inventory: one row per floor of each MIT building, with floor areas (assignable, non-assignable, exterior gross) and access level. Joins to FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING and is referenced by room-level tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS).

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: access_level
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Coded building/floor access level, 0-3, predominantly 2. Exact code meanings (e.g. public vs restricted) are not evidenced; only the ordinal scale 0-3 is clear.

ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: assignable_area_sqft
ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Assignable floor area in square feet (rooms usable for programs: offices, labs, classrooms); 0 for floors with no assignable space.

BUILDING_KEY.name: building_key
BUILDING_KEY.description: Building identifier (MIT building number/code, e.g. E19, W20, 54, OC19Q). References FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING / BUILDINGS.

BUILDING_WINGS_ID.name: building_wings_id
BUILDING_WINGS_ID.description: Identifier of the wing(s) a floor belongs to, formatted as building code + wing letter + floor segment (e.g. W61A.2). Populated for only ~1.4% of rows; some values list multiple wings.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: ext_gross_area_sqft
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: Exterior gross floor area in square feet (total floor area measured to exterior walls), including assignable and non-assignable space.

FLOOR.name: floor
FLOOR.description: Floor designation within the building, mostly numeric ('0'-'30') but including non-numeric labels such as 'D6' and zero-padded values ('00'). Part of the composite key with BUILDING_KEY.

FLOOR_KEY.name: floor_key
FLOOR_KEY.description: Primary key: composite 'building-floor' code (e.g. E19-2, W85-14). One-to-one with FCLT_FLOOR.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY; referenced by room tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST).

FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.name: floor_sort_sequence
FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.description: Numeric sort order for floors, mapping floor labels to integers including negatives for basement levels (e.g. -2, -3).

LEVEL_ID.name: level_id
LEVEL_ID.description: Numeric level number within the building, negative for basement levels; ~11% null. Essentially the same as FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE where populated; the distinction between the two is not evidenced.

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: non_assignable_area_sqft
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area in square feet (circulation, mechanical, restrooms, etc.).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: FAC_MAJOR_USE
table.purpose: Lookup table of facility space major-use categories (e.g., classrooms, laboratories, circulation, mechanical) used to classify rooms in the facilities/space data. Referenced by room tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS, and their history tables) via MAJOR_USE_KEY / MAJOR_USE_DESC. Appears to be the current counterpart of FCLT_MAJOR_USE and its history table FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST.

ASSIGNABLE.name: Assignable flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: Indicates whether space in this major-use category is assignable/assignable-to-a-department space (1 = yes, 0 = no). Non-assignable categories include circulation, mechanical, and building service areas.

DESCRIPTION.name: Major use description
DESCRIPTION.description: Full-text description of the major space-use category (e.g., 'CLASSROOMS', 'CIRCULATION AREA', 'MECHANICAL AREA').

MAJOR_USE.name: Major use code
MAJOR_USE.description: Short 8-character code for the space-use category (e.g., CIRCULAT, CLASSRMS, MECHANIC). Joins one-to-one to FCLT_MAJOR_USE.MAJOR_USE and is referenced by room tables as MAJOR_USE_DESC.

MAJOR_USE_KEY.name: Major use key
MAJOR_USE_KEY.description: Primary key; numeric surrogate key (101-114) identifying each major-use category. Referenced by FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST, and FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (all rows show 19-DEC-24, the last full load).

table.name: FAC_ORGANIZATION
table.purpose: Facilities/space-management dimension table of MIT organizational units (departments, labs, centers, administrative offices) that can own or occupy space, with hierarchy (parent org, major org, level) and links to HR department codes and space/room tables. One row per organization (169 rows).

ASSIGNABLE.name: Space assignable to organization
ASSIGNABLE.description: Flag (0/1) indicating whether the organization's space is assignable; 1 for 166 of 169 rows.

COURSE.name: Course number
COURSE.description: SIS course/subject number for organizations tied to an academic subject area (e.g. '21F', 'STS'); null for ~81% of rows (non-academic units). Joins to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER.

DESCRIPTION.name: Full organization description
DESCRIPTION.description: Long-form name of the organization (e.g. 'Dept of Earth, Atmospheric, & Planetary Sciences'); null for ~61% of rows where ORGANIZATION_NAME suffices.

D_CODE.name: Department DLC code
D_CODE.description: Department/lab/center code prefixed 'D_' (e.g. D_MECHE, D_FACILITIES) used in the master department hierarchy tables.

HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.name: HR department number (old)
HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.description: Legacy HR department number (e.g. 310000 Lincoln Laboratory); nearly identical to ORGANIZATION_NUMBER. Joins to SPACE_UNIT.

HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: HR department name
HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Official HR department name for the organization (e.g. 'Lincoln Laboratory').

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: HR org unit ID
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: HR organizational unit identifier (10000xxx) linking to HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

MAJOR_ORG.name: Major organization code
MAJOR_ORG.description: Code of the top-level executive area the org reports to: PROVST (Provost), CHNCLR (Chancellor), EXECVP (Executive VP), PRES, VP-SCP, ZORG, ALL, etc.

MAJOR_ORG_KEY.name: Major organization key
MAJOR_ORG_KEY.description: Numeric key of the parent major organization (e.g. 230 = Provost, 129 = Chancellor, 163 = Executive VP); matches ORGANIZATION_KEY of the top-level org.

ORGANIZATION.name: Organization code
ORGANIZATION.description: Short unique organization code (e.g. LINCLB, RAS, MECH) used by FAC_ROOMS / FCLT_ROOMS as ORGANIZATION_NAME and as parent code in FCLT_ORGANIZATION.

ORGANIZATION_ID.name: Organization ID
ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Numeric ID of the organization; identical values to ORGANIZATION_KEY (duplicate column).

ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: Organization key (primary key)
ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Primary key of the table; numeric key (101-288) referenced by FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, etc.

ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.name: Hierarchy level
ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.description: Depth of the org in the hierarchy, 1 (top, e.g. ALL/PRES) to 6; most units are level 5. The detected join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap) and should be ignored.

ORGANIZATION_NAME.name: Organization name
ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: Unique short name of the organization (e.g. 'LINCOLN LAB', 'RSCH ADMIN SERVICES').

ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.name: Organization (HR department) number
ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.description: HR department number for the org (e.g. 310000); essentially the same as HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD. Joins to SPACE_UNIT.

ORGANIZATION_SORT.name: Sort code
ORGANIZATION_SORT.description: Nine-digit code encoding the hierarchy path for sorting orgs in reports (e.g. 101060260); segments appear to encode parent chain.

ORG_PARENT.name: Parent organization code
ORG_PARENT.description: Code of the parent organization in the hierarchy (e.g. VP-RES, EXECVP, S ENG); 'ALL' at the top.

ORG_PARENT_KEY.name: Parent organization key
ORG_PARENT_KEY.description: Numeric key of the parent organization, matching ORGANIZATION_KEY of the parent row.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows.

table.name: FAC_ROOMS
table.purpose: Facilities space inventory: one row per room/space in a building, with its floor, area, use classification, and owning organization. MIT-style building-room keys (e.g. W34-1-110). Snapshot loaded 19-DEC-24; many descriptive columns are unpopulated in this load.

AREA.name: Room area (square feet)
AREA.description: Floor area of the room, most likely in square feet (median ~122, max ~24,000).

BUILDING_KEY.name: Building key
BUILDING_KEY.description: Building identifier (MIT building number like 46, E37, W85A). References FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING / BUILDINGS.

FAC_ROOM_KEY.name: Room key
FAC_ROOM_KEY.description: Primary key: building number plus room number, e.g. 18-158, W34-110.

FLOOR.name: Floor number
FLOOR.description: Floor of the building, mostly numeric (0-29) but includes codes like D6; the accepted join to SPACE_USAGE is likely spurious.

FLOOR_KEY.name: Floor key
FLOOR_KEY.description: Composite building-floor key (e.g. 46-4, OC31-2). References FAC_FLOOR / FCLT_FLOOR.

MAJOR_USE_DESC.name: Major use code
MAJOR_USE_DESC.description: Major space-use category code (CIRCULAT, MECHANIC, BLDG SRV, LABS, RESIDENT, OFFICES, GENERAL). References FAC_MAJOR_USE.MAJOR_USE.

MAJOR_USE_KEY.name: Major use key
MAJOR_USE_KEY.description: Numeric key for the major space-use category; references FAC_MAJOR_USE.MAJOR_USE_KEY (102=circulation, 107=mechanical, 109=residential, etc.).

ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: Owning organization key
ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Key of the organization responsible for the room (149/DOF dominates). References FAC_ORGANIZATION / FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.

ORGANIZATION_NAME.name: Owning organization code
ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: Short code of the owning organization (DOF, MIBR, RESIDE, RESDOF, PILM, DCM, BCS). References FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION.

SPACE_ID.name: Space identifier
SPACE_ID.description: Unique composite identifier building-floor-room, e.g. 18-1-158, W34-1-110.

USE_KEY.name: Specific use key
USE_KEY.description: Numeric code for the room's specific use category (32 distinct values, 101-204), presumably a space-use lookup; no accepted join found so exact labels unresolved.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the warehouse; single value 19-DEC-24 for this snapshot.

table.name: FCLT_BUILDING
table.purpose: Facilities building inventory: one row per MIT building (campus and off-campus), with name, type/use, areas, room counts, location coordinates, ownership, dates, and parent-building relationships. Referenced by floor, room, and address tables; has history tables (FCLT_BUILDING_HIST).

ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE.name: Access level code
ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE.description: Numeric code for the building's access/security level; values 0, 1, 2 with 2 most common (185/242). Exact meaning of each level is not defined by a lookup table here.

ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Assignable area (sq ft)
