BUILDING_WINGS_ID.name: BUILDING_WINGS_ID
BUILDING_WINGS_ID.description: Identifier(s) of the building wing(s) the floor belongs to; only populated for a few buildings (e.g. W61 wings A-M). Format like 'W61A.1' = wing A, floor/section 1. Mostly null.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: EXT_GROSS_AREA
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: Exterior gross area of the floor in square feet (total floor area measured to the outside of exterior walls).

FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.name: FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.description: Building identifier (MIT building number, e.g. E19, W20, 45); references FCLT_BUILDING / FAC_BUILDING.

FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.name: FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.description: Primary key: building number + floor number, e.g. 'E19-2', 'W20-0'. Referenced by FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST, FCLT_FLOOR_HIST, FAC_ROOMS, FAC_FLOOR.

FLOOR.name: FLOOR
FLOOR.description: Floor number as displayed (0-30, with some non-numeric codes like 'D6' and zero-padded '00'); 0 = ground floor. The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.name: FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE
FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.description: Numeric sort order for the floor (negative values for basement/sub-basement levels, e.g. -2, -3), used to order floors correctly. The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

LEVEL_ID.name: LEVEL_ID
LEVEL_ID.description: Numeric level identifier (0-26, negatives for below-grade levels); similar to FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE but null for ~11% of rows. The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area in square feet (circulation, mechanical, restrooms, etc.).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: FCLT_FLOOR_HIST
table.purpose: Monthly (fiscal-period) snapshot history of facility floors: one row per building floor per fiscal month, recording floor areas and access level. It is the history companion of FCLT_FLOOR, keyed by building-floor plus fiscal period (FISCAL_PERIOD, 201505-201602). Areas appear to be in square feet (assignable + non-assignable roughly summing to external gross area).

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: ACCESS_LEVEL
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Coded access/security level of the floor, values 0-3, predominantly 2. Exact meaning of each code is not documented; unresolved beyond being a 4-level code.

ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: ASSIGNABLE_AREA
ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Assignable floor area in square feet (space assignable to occupants/programs); 0 for some floors.

BUILDING_WINGS_ID.name: BUILDING_WINGS_ID
BUILDING_WINGS_ID.description: Identifier(s) of the building wing(s) the floor belongs to (e.g. W61A.1, W61B.2); mostly null; can hold multiple space-separated wing IDs.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: EXT_GROSS_AREA
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: External gross area of the floor in square feet (total floor area including walls/non-assignable space).

FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.name: FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.description: Building identifier (MIT building number, e.g. W61A, E55, 54); references FCLT_BUILDING / FAC_BUILDING.

FCLT_FLOOR_HIST_KEY.name: FCLT_FLOOR_HIST_KEY
FCLT_FLOOR_HIST_KEY.description: Primary key: composite of building key, floor, and fiscal period (e.g. W61A-2-201505).

FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.name: FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.description: Building-floor identifier (building key + floor, e.g. W61A-2); references FCLT_FLOOR / FAC_FLOOR.

FISCAL_PERIOD.name: FISCAL_PERIOD
FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Fiscal period (YYYYMM) of the snapshot, 201505-201602; references TIME_MONTH.

FLOOR.name: FLOOR
FLOOR.description: Floor number/label within the building (0-30, plus non-numeric labels like 'D6', '00'). The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.name: FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE
FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.description: Numeric sort order for the floor label, allowing basement/sublevel floors to sort correctly (values include negatives, e.g. -2). The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

LEVEL_ID.name: LEVEL_ID
LEVEL_ID.description: Numeric level identifier of the floor, essentially the floor number as an integer (including negatives for sublevels); nearly identical to FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE. The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area in square feet (circulation, mechanical, restrooms, etc.).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (first of month, DD-MON-YY format), one per fiscal period snapshot.

table.name: FCLT_MAJOR_USE
table.purpose: Lookup table of facility space major-use categories (e.g., classrooms, laboratories, circulation, mechanical) used to classify rooms in the facilities space data. Referenced by room tables (FCLT_ROOMS, FAC_ROOMS and their history tables).

ASSIGNABLE.name: Assignable flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: Indicates whether rooms in this major-use category count as assignable space (1, e.g., classrooms, general use) versus non-assignable space (0, e.g., circulation, mechanical, building service).

DESCRIPTION.name: Major use description
DESCRIPTION.description: Full-text description of the space major-use category (e.g., 'CLASSROOMS', 'CIRCULATION AREA', 'MECHANICAL AREA').

FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.name: Major use key
FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.description: Primary key; surrogate key (101-114) for the major-use category, referenced by room tables (FCLT_ROOMS, FAC_ROOMS and history tables).

MAJOR_USE.name: Major use code
MAJOR_USE.description: Short 8-character code for the major-use category (e.g., 'CLASSRMS', 'CIRCULAT', 'MECHANIC'), matching FAC_MAJOR_USE and used as a join code in room tables.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; all rows loaded 19-DEC-24.

table.name: FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST
table.purpose: History table of facility space major-use category definitions, one row per major-use code per fiscal period, tracking whether each use category was considered assignable space and how it was described over time. It is the historical (point-in-time) version of FCLT_MAJOR_USE, keyed by major-use code plus fiscal period.

ASSIGNABLE.name: ASSIGNABLE
ASSIGNABLE.description: Flag indicating whether space in this major-use category counts as assignable space (1 = assignable, 0 = not assignable). E.g. classrooms/labs are 1, mechanical/circulation areas are 0.

DESCRIPTION.name: DESCRIPTION
DESCRIPTION.description: Full descriptive label of the major-use category (e.g. 'CLASSROOMS', 'CIRCULATION AREA', 'MECHANICAL AREA', 'UNCLASSIFIED').

FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST_KEY.name: FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST_KEY
FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST_KEY.description: Primary key of the history table: concatenation of the major-use key and the fiscal period (e.g. '114-202211').

FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.name: FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY
FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.description: Numeric key (101-114) of the major-use category; foreign key to FCLT_MAJOR_USE / FAC_MAJOR_USE lookup tables.

FISCAL_PERIOD.name: FISCAL_PERIOD
FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Fiscal period (year+month, e.g. 202307) for which this version of the major-use definition applies; joins to TIME_MONTH.

MAJOR_USE.name: MAJOR_USE
MAJOR_USE.description: Short 8-character code for the major-use category (e.g. 'CLASSRMS', 'CIRCULAT', 'MECHANIC', 'UNCLASS'); foreign key to FAC_MAJOR_USE / FCLT_MAJOR_USE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (DD-MON-YY format); one load per fiscal period snapshot.

table.name: FCLT_ORGANIZATION
table.purpose: Facilities (space management) dimension of MIT organizational units: one row per DLC/department-level organization that can own or be assigned space, with its hierarchy (parent, major org, level), HR department codes, and course-subject code where applicable. It is the facilities-side counterpart of FAC_ORGANIZATION, with a companion history table FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST and a DLC crosswalk FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY. Rows are MIT departments, labs, and centers (DLCs).

ASSIGNABLE.name: assignable_flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: Whether the organization can be assigned space (1 = yes, 0 = no). 175 of 180 rows are 1.

COURSE.name: course_subject_code
COURSE.description: SIS subject/course code for academic departments that teach subjects (e.g. 21L = Literature, 21F, STS). Null for non-academic units. Joins to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER.

DESCRIPTION.name: organization_description
DESCRIPTION.description: Longer human-readable description of the unit (e.g. 'Dept of Earth, Atmospheric, & Planetary Sciences'). Null for many rows.

DLC_KEY.name: dlc_key
DLC_KEY.description: Department/Lab/Center key (e.g. D_LIT, D_EAPS) used in the master department hierarchy; joins to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY.

DLC_NAME.name: dlc_name
DLC_NAME.description: Human-readable DLC name matching DLC_KEY (e.g. 'Literature', 'Department of Facilities').

FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY.name: major_org_key
FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY.description: Key of the top-level (major) organization this unit rolls up to (e.g. 230 = Provost, 129 = Chancellor, 163 = Executive VP); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_KEY.

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: organization_key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Primary key: surrogate key of the organization unit in the facilities system; equals ORGANIZATION_ID.

FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.name: parent_org_key
FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.description: Key of the parent organization in the facilities org hierarchy (self-referencing to FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY / FAC_ORGANIZATION).

HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.name: hr_department_code_old
HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.description: Legacy HR department number (e.g. 591040, 93600); largely overlaps ORGANIZATION_NUMBER. Joins to SPACE_UNIT codes.

HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: hr_department_name
HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: HR system's name for the department (e.g. 'Literature Section', 'MIT Sea Grant College Program').

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: hr_org_unit_id
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: HR organizational unit identifier (10000xxx); joins to HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

MAJOR_ORG.name: major_org_code
MAJOR_ORG.description: Code of the top-level executive area the unit reports to: PROVST (Provost), CHNCLR (Chancellor), EXECVP (Executive VP), PRES, ZORG, etc.

ORGANIZATION.name: organization_code
ORGANIZATION.description: Short organization code (e.g. LIT, AERO, MECH, DOFADM); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION.

ORGANIZATION_ID.name: organization_id
ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Numeric organization identifier, identical to FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY; joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID.

ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.name: hierarchy_level
ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.description: Depth of the unit in the org hierarchy, 1 (top, e.g. ALL/PRES) to 6; most units are at level 5. The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap), not a real reference.

ORGANIZATION_NAME.name: organization_name
ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: Uppercase organization name (e.g. 'LITERATURE', 'MCGOVERN INSTITUTE'); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME.

ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.name: organization_number
ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.description: HR/space department number for the unit (e.g. 93600 for Literature); joins to SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE/KEY.

ORGANIZATION_SORT.name: sort_key
ORGANIZATION_SORT.description: Numeric sort key encoding hierarchy position for display ordering (values like 101060148).

ORG_PARENT.name: parent_org_code
ORG_PARENT.description: Code of the parent organization (e.g. 'S H&SS' = School of Humanities, Arts & Social Sciences, 'EXECVP', 'S ENG' = School of Engineering); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (single value 19-DEC-24 for all rows, i.e. this snapshot's load date).

table.name: FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST
table.purpose: Monthly (fiscal-period) snapshot history of MIT facility/space-owning organizations (DLCs and administrative units), tracking their hierarchy, HR department linkage, and space-assignment attributes over time. Each row is one organization as of one fiscal period (YYYYMM).

ASSIGNABLE.name: assignable_flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: Boolean flag (0/1) indicating whether the organization's space is assignable (e.g., assignable square footage vs. non-assignable). 1 for ~97.5% of rows.

COURSE.name: course_number
COURSE.description: Course/subject number associated with the organization (e.g., academic department course codes like 21, 21F, IMES, STS). Populated for only ~19% of rows, mostly academic departments; joins to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER.

DESCRIPTION.name: organization_description
DESCRIPTION.description: Long-form description of the organization (e.g., 'Institute For Medical Engineering & Science'). Sparsely populated (~2%); appears only for some centers/institutes.

DLC_KEY.name: dlc_key
DLC_KEY.description: Department, Lab, or Center (DLC) code prefixed with 'D_' (e.g., D_MECHE = Mechanical Engineering, D_FACILITIES = Department of Facilities). Joins to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.

DLC_NAME.name: dlc_name
DLC_NAME.description: Full name of the Department, Lab, or Center corresponding to DLC_KEY (e.g., 'Department of Facilities', 'Mechanical Engineering').

FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY.name: major_org_key
FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY.description: Key of the top-level/major organization the unit rolls up to; either a numeric organization key (e.g., 230) or a code (PROVST, CHNCLR, EXECVP, ALL).

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST_KEY.name: organization_hist_key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST_KEY.description: Primary key: composite of organization key and fiscal period, e.g., '150-202010' = organization 150 as of 2020-10.

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: organization_key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Surrogate key of the facility organization (101-277); joins to FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, FAC_ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT.

FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.name: parent_organization_key
FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.description: Organization key of the parent unit in the facility organization hierarchy (self-referencing to FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY).

FISCAL_PERIOD.name: fiscal_period
FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Fiscal period (year-month, YYYYMM) of the snapshot, e.g., 201510; joins to TIME_MONTH.

HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.name: hr_department_code_old
HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.description: Legacy HR department number (e.g., 591040, 409000) linking the facility organization to the HR/payroll department structure; joins to SPACE_UNIT.

HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: hr_department_name
HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the HR department corresponding to HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD (e.g., 'Dining', 'Human Resources').

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: hr_org_unit_id
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: HR organizational unit identifier (10000xxx); joins to HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

MAJOR_ORG.name: major_org
MAJOR_ORG.description: Code of the major (top-level) organization the unit belongs to; either a mnemonic (PROVST, CHNCLR, EXECVP, OTHMIT, ALL) or, in some periods, an HR department number (e.g., 402100).

ORGANIZATION.name: organization_code
ORGANIZATION.description: Short organization code (e.g., DOFADM, S ENG, AERO, MECH); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION.

ORGANIZATION_ID.name: organization_id
ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Numeric organization identifier (101-277), same value as FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY; joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.

ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.name: organization_level
ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.description: Depth level of the unit in the organization hierarchy (1-6, with 5 most common). The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious; values are hierarchy levels, not space-usage codes.

ORGANIZATION_NAME.name: organization_name
ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: Abbreviated organization name (e.g., 'DP OF FACIL ADM', 'SCH OF ENGINEER'); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME.

ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.name: organization_number
ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.description: HR-style department number for the organization (e.g., 591040, 60000); largely overlaps HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD but with some differing values; joins to SPACE_UNIT.

ORGANIZATION_SORT.name: organization_sort_key
ORGANIZATION_SORT.description: Numeric sort key (9-digit, ~101xxxxxx) used to order organizations in reports/hierarchy display.

ORG_PARENT.name: parent_organization_code
ORG_PARENT.description: Short code of the parent organization (e.g., S ENG, EXECVP, PROVST); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (DD-MON-YY format), typically the first or last day of a month, aligned with the fiscal period.

table.name: FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY
table.purpose: Crosswalk mapping MIT department/ lab/center (DLC) codes to facility-space organization keys, linking the DLC code used in department hierarchy tables to the FCLT_ORGANIZATION entity used in the space/facilities data warehouse. Each row associates one DLC code (e.g. D_MECHE) with one facility organization key. Some DLC codes map to multiple organization keys and some rows have no DLC code, so it is not a strict one-to-one mapping table. The 4.8% null rate on DLC_KEY suggests some facility organizations have no DLC equivalent. The table is likely a load/translation table (cf. ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD) rather than a core entity, since it has no primary key and only two columns.

DLC_KEY.name: DLC_KEY
DLC_KEY.description: Department, Lab, or Center (DLC) code, prefixed with 'D_' (e.g. D_MECHE = Mechanical Engineering, D_DUSP = Urban Studies and Planning, D_PROVOST = Provost's office). References MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY, so this is the DLC identifier used in the department hierarchy. Null for ~5% of rows, meaning some facility organizations have no corresponding DLC code. Not unique in this table (some DLCs appear multiple times, e.g. D_RESDEV appears 4 times), suggesting a DLC can be associated with multiple facility organizations or the mapping is historical.

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Foreign key to FCLT_ORGANIZATION (and its history table), the facility-space organization entity. Referenced by FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST, FAC_ROOMS, FAC_ORGANIZATION, and SPACE_UNIT, confirming it identifies an organization that owns or occupies space. Unique within this table (168 distinct values in 168 rows), so each facility organization appears at most once. Values are integers in the range 101-288.

table.name: FCLT_ROOMS
table.purpose: Facilities room inventory: one row per room (or room-level space) in MIT buildings, with its building, floor, room number, floor area, space use classification, and owning organization. Companion to FAC_ROOMS / FCLT_ROOMS_HIST in a facilities space data warehouse (loaded 19-DEC-24).

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: access_level
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Numeric code for the room's access/security level; values 0-3. Exact meaning of each level is not defined by the data.

AREA.name: area_sq_ft
AREA.description: Floor area of the room, almost certainly in square feet (median ~140, max ~108,475).

BUILDING_ROOM.name: building_room
BUILDING_ROOM.description: Room identifier combining building number and room number, e.g. 'E37-799A' = building E37, room 799A. Same value as FCLT_ROOM_KEY.

DEPT_CODE.name: dept_code
DEPT_CODE.description: Department/space-unit code (5-digit, 93300-93800) for the few rooms assigned to a department; references SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE. Populated for <0.3% of rows; specific meaning of the 93xxx codes is unresolved.

EASTING_SPCS.name: easting_spcs
EASTING_SPCS.description: East-west coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System (SPCS) for the room. Entirely null in this snapshot.

FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.name: fclt_building_key
FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.description: Foreign key to FCLT_BUILDING (building number, e.g. 'E37', '46', 'W85A').

FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.name: fclt_floor_key
FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.description: Foreign key to FCLT_FLOOR; composite building-floor key, e.g. '46-7' = building 46, floor 7.

FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.name: fclt_major_use_key
FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.description: Foreign key to FCLT_MAJOR_USE; major space-use category (102=CIRCULATION AREA, 107=MECHANICAL AREA, 108=OFFICES, 109=RESIDENTIAL, 113=UNCLASSIFIED, etc.).

FCLT_MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: fclt_minor_organization_key
FCLT_MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Foreign key to a minor organization (sub-unit) owning the room. Entirely null in this snapshot.

FCLT_MINOR_USE_KEY.name: fclt_minor_use_key
FCLT_MINOR_USE_KEY.description: Foreign key to a minor (finer-grained) space-use category. Entirely null in this snapshot.

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: fclt_organization_key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Foreign key to FCLT_ORGANIZATION / FAC_ORGANIZATION; the DLC (department, lab, or center) that owns/occupies the room (e.g. 149=DOF, 236=RESIDE, 245=S Mgmt).

FCLT_USE_KEY.name: fclt_use_key
FCLT_USE_KEY.description: Detailed space-use code (101-204) for the room; presumably joins a use/room-use lookup table not present in the accepted joins. Specific code meanings unresolved.

FLOOR.name: floor_number
FLOOR.description: Floor number within the building (0-30, with some non-numeric codes like 'D6' and zero-padded values like '00'). The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious; this is the floor component of the room ID.

LATITUDE_WGS.name: latitude_wgs
LATITUDE_WGS.description: Latitude in WGS84 coordinates for the room. Entirely null in this snapshot.

LONGITUDE_WGS.name: longitude_wgs
LONGITUDE_WGS.description: Longitude in WGS84 coordinates for the room. Entirely null in this snapshot.

MAJOR_USE_DESC.name: major_use_desc
MAJOR_USE_DESC.description: 8-character abbreviation of the major space-use category, matching FCLT_MAJOR_USE.MAJOR_USE (CIRCULAT=CIRCULATION AREA, MECHANIC=MECHANICAL AREA, RESIDENT=RESIDENTIAL, OFFICES, LABS, etc.).

MINOR_ORGANIZATION.name: minor_organization
MINOR_ORGANIZATION.description: Minor organization code/name for the room. Entirely null in this snapshot.

MINOR_USE_DESC.name: minor_use_desc
MINOR_USE_DESC.description: Description of the minor space-use category. Entirely null in this snapshot.

NORTHING_SPCS.name: northing_spcs
NORTHING_SPCS.description: North-south coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System (SPCS) for the room. Entirely null in this snapshot.

ORGANIZATION_NAME.name: organization_name
ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: Short name/abbreviation of the owning organization (DLC), matching FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION: DOF (Department of Facilities), RESIDE (Housing/Residential), S MGMT, AERO, MECH, PHYSIC, BIOLGY, etc.

ROOM.name: room_number
ROOM.description: Room number within the building, e.g. '799A', '395C', '055'.

ROOM_FULL_NAME.name: room_full_name
ROOM_FULL_NAME.description: Full descriptive name of named rooms (e.g. 'COMPTON LOUNGE', 'KRESGE LOBBY'). Populated for <0.2% of rooms; most rooms are unnamed.

SPACE_ID.name: space_id
SPACE_ID.description: Composite space identifier building-floor-room, e.g. 'E37-7-799A'. Nearly unique per row.

USE_DESC.name: use_desc
USE_DESC.description: Description of the detailed space use. Entirely null in this snapshot.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: FCLT_ROOMS_HIST
table.purpose: Historical snapshot of MIT facility/space room inventory as of fiscal period 201505 (May 2015). One row per room per fiscal period, describing building, floor, room number, area, use classification, and owning organization. Companion history table to FCLT_ROOMS, keyed by FCLT_ROOM_HIST_KEY (room key + fiscal period).

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: Access level
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Coded room access/security level, values 0-3 (0 most restrictive, 3 least, or vice versa). Exact code meanings are not defined in this table; likely a facility access classification.

AREA.name: Room area
AREA.description: Floor area of the room in square feet (values 0.11 to 108,885, median ~150).

BUILDING_ROOM.name: Building-room identifier
BUILDING_ROOM.description: Building number and room number concatenated, e.g. '3-261' = building 3, room 261. Same as FCLT_ROOM_KEY.

DEPT_CODE.name: Department code
DEPT_CODE.description: SIS/space department code (93xxx range) for the room's occupying department; populated for only ~1.8% of rows. References SPACE_UNIT.

EASTING_SPCS.name: Easting (SPCS)
EASTING_SPCS.description: East-west coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System; entirely null in this snapshot.

FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.name: Building key

ATTENDANCE.description: Attendance policy: 'Participants welcome at individual sessions', 'Participants must attend all sessions', or 'Other'.

CREATE_DATE.name: CREATE_DATE
CREATE_DATE.description: Date the activity record was created, in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 18-DEC-20).

ENROLLMENT_TYPE.name: ENROLLMENT_TYPE
ENROLLMENT_TYPE.description: Sign-up/enrollment policy: advance sign-up required, no advance sign-up, first come first served, or Other.

FEE.name: FEE
FEE.description: Fee charged for the activity, in US dollars; null for the ~94% of free activities.

FEE_REASON.name: FEE_REASON
FEE_REASON.description: Explanation of what the fee covers (e.g. class registration, kit and fabricated parts, per-lesson pricing).

IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY.name: IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY.description: Surrogate key referencing IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY, the activity's topical category (e.g. Climate, Economics and Finance, Diversity and Inclusion).

IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY.name: IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY.description: Surrogate key presumably referencing IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON (the organizer/contact). Its values are identical to IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY in every row, so it may actually be the session/subject key rather than a distinct person key; the exact referent is unresolved.

IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.name: IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.description: Surrogate key referencing IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION, identifying the activity's session(s). Same value as IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY in all rows.

IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.name: IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.description: Surrogate key referencing IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR, the sponsoring group (e.g. Lincoln Laboratory, Biology, Libraries).

IS_CANCELLED.name: IS_CANCELLED
IS_CANCELLED.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the activity was cancelled (only 2 of 465 were).

IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION.name: IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION
IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the activity runs over multiple sessions.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date of the last session of the activity, DD-MON-YY format; all fall in the January 2021 IAP window.

MAX_ENROLLMENT.name: MAX_ENROLLMENT
MAX_ENROLLMENT.description: Maximum number of participants allowed; null when unlimited/no cap. The detected join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap).

PREREG_DEADLINE.name: PREREG_DEADLINE
PREREG_DEADLINE.description: Deadline to pre-register/sign up, DD-MON-YY format; null when no advance sign-up is required.

PREREQUISITES.name: PREREQUISITES
PREREQUISITES.description: Free-text prerequisites or requirements for participation (e.g. 'none', 'Instructor approval', programming experience).

TERM_CODE.name: TERM_CODE
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code; '2021JA' = January/IAP 2021. Constant in this extract.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (19-DEC-24 for all rows).

table.name: IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON
table.purpose: People associated with MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) subjects/activities, with their role (activity leader, session leader, contact person) and contact details. Each row is one person attached to one IAP subject/session; the key likely encodes the subject/session plus person. Links conceptually to IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION / IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL, though no explicit joins were detected.

IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY.name: IAP subject-person link key
IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY.description: Opaque surrogate key (hex string) identifying a person's attachment to an IAP subject/session. Not unique per row (390 distinct over 1113 rows), so it likely identifies the subject/session and repeats for each person attached to it.

PERSON_EMAIL.name: Person email address
PERSON_EMAIL.description: Email address of the person; 65% null. Domains like worker.com/hotmail.com suggest anonymized/synthesized data.

PERSON_LOCATION.name: Office/room location
PERSON_LOCATION.description: MIT building-room location (e.g., NW16-250, E23-392A) where the person can be found; mostly null.

PERSON_MIT_AFFILIATION.name: MIT affiliation
PERSON_MIT_AFFILIATION.description: Person's relationship to MIT: Staff, Non-MIT, Research Staff, MIT Professor, Grad Student, etc.

PERSON_NAME.name: Person full name
PERSON_NAME.description: Full name of the person; nearly unique per row. Values appear anonymized.

PERSON_ROLE.name: Role in IAP activity
PERSON_ROLE.description: The person's role for the IAP subject: Activity leader, Contact person, or Session leader.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; single value 19-DEC-24 for all rows.

table.name: IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION
table.purpose: Individual meeting/session records for MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) subjects — one row per scheduled session (date, times, location, title/description) of an IAP offering, keyed to the IAP subject detail table. Data appears to be from IAP January 2021 (mostly virtual/Zoom sessions).

HAS_SESSION_INFO.name: has_session_info
HAS_SESSION_INFO.description: Flag indicating whether the subject has session-level scheduling info; 'Y' for nearly all rows, 'N' for 18 rows (likely subjects with no session detail).

IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.name: iap_subject_session_key
IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.description: Opaque surrogate key linking the session to its parent IAP subject (presumably joins to IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL); not unique here, so multiple sessions share a subject key.

SESSION_DATE.name: session_date
SESSION_DATE.description: Date of the session, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 14-JAN-21); all dates fall in January 2021, consistent with IAP.

SESSION_DESCRIPTION.name: session_description
SESSION_DESCRIPTION.description: HTML-formatted free-text description of the session's content (e.g., 'Course Intro and Chapter 1'); null for about half the rows.

SESSION_END_TIME.name: session_end_time
SESSION_END_TIME.description: Session end time as text in HHMMAM/PM format (e.g., '0300PM' = 3:00 PM).

SESSION_LOCATION.name: session_location
SESSION_LOCATION.description: Where the session is held; free text dominated by virtual/Zoom variants for 2021, otherwise a room or building name.

SESSION_START_TIME.name: session_start_time
SESSION_START_TIME.description: Session start time as text in HHMMAM/PM format (e.g., '0100PM' = 1:00 PM).

SESSION_TITLE.name: session_title
SESSION_TITLE.description: Title of the individual session (e.g., 'Session 4: Transmission expansion'); null when the session has no distinct title.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows.

table.name: IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR
table.purpose: Lookup table of sponsors (departments, centers, labs, student groups, etc.) for MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) subjects; referenced by IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.

IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.name: IAP subject sponsor surrogate key
IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.description: Primary key; opaque system-generated hex identifier for a sponsor record. Referenced by IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.

SPONSOR_NAME.name: Sponsor name
SPONSOR_NAME.description: Display name of the IAP sponsor, e.g. 'Lincoln Laboratory', 'Biology', 'Society of Physics Students'.

SPONSOR_TYPE.name: Sponsor type
SPONSOR_TYPE.description: Classification of the sponsor: Academic Department, Administrative Department, Student Group, Center, Lab, Other MIT Groups.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (all rows 19-DEC-24); an ETL timestamp, not a business date.

table.name: IR_INSTITUTION
table.purpose: Institutional Research reference table of higher-education institutions worldwide (one row per institution), with name, address, country, and Carnegie-classification category. Likely used to code institutions of origin (e.g., for transfer/exchange/study-abroad or prior-education data) in an MIT institutional research warehouse.

ALTERNATE_INSTITUTION_NAME.name: alternate_institution_name
ALTERNATE_INSTITUTION_NAME.description: Alternate or former name of the institution; populated for about 15% of rows.

CITY.name: city
CITY.description: City in which the institution is located.

COUNTRY.name: country
COUNTRY.description: Full country name of the institution's location (uppercase ISO-style names, e.g. UNITED STATES, JAPAN).

COUNTRY_CODE.name: country_code
COUNTRY_CODE.description: Two-letter ISO country code matching COUNTRY (US, JP, CN, ...).

INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_LABEL.name: institution_category_label
INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_LABEL.description: Human-readable Carnegie Classification category of the institution (e.g. 'Master's Colleges and Universities (larger programs)'); '-3' code rendered as 'Not applicable, not in Carnegie universe'. Values carry a trailing newline.

INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_VALUE.name: institution_category_value
INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_VALUE.description: Numeric Carnegie Classification category code paired with INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_LABEL; -3 = not in Carnegie universe (not accredited / nondegree-granting). The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is spurious (room-use codes) and should be ignored.

INSTITUTION_ID.name: institution_id
INSTITUTION_ID.description: Primary key; unique institution identifier. Six-digit numeric IDs (e.g. 225548) resemble IPEDS/Carnegie institution IDs; IDs prefixed 'F' (e.g. F01323) appear to flag foreign institutions.

INSTITUTION_SORT_ORDER.name: institution_sort_order
INSTITUTION_SORT_ORDER.description: Numeric sort key for displaying institutions in a preferred order (e.g. US institutions first, then by country); 900/999 likely sentinels for low-priority/other groupings. Exact ordering logic unresolved.

RECORD_CREATED_DATE.name: record_created_date
RECORD_CREATED_DATE.description: Date the record was loaded/created, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format; bulk load 17-JUL-14 with later incremental loads in 2024.

STATE.name: state
STATE.description: Two-letter US state/territory code (includes PR); null for non-US institutions.

STREET_ADDRESS.name: street_address
STREET_ADDRESS.description: Street address of the institution (mixed formatting/case).

ZIP.name: zip
ZIP.description: US ZIP (or ZIP+4) postal code; null for non-US rows. Some non-US postal codes may be present.

table.name: LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR
table.purpose: Maps MIT courses (by subject number, term, and instructor) to the MIT library unit (branch) that holds course reserves for that course in that term. Each row is one course-instructor-term combination assigned to a library reserve unit, with the term's date range and the warehouse ETL load date. The key encodes course number, instructor name, and term (e.g. 21F.107-KIDD2011SU:21F.107).

COURSE_NAME.name: course_title
COURSE_NAME.description: Human-readable title of the course (e.g. 'Calculus', 'Chinese I (Streamlined)').

DATE_FROM.name: term_start_date
DATE_FROM.description: Start date of the academic term in which the course/reserve applies, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. 06-SEP-11).

DATE_TO.name: term_end_date
DATE_TO.description: End date of the term, DD-MON-YY text. The value 31-MAY-31 appears to be an open-ended/placeholder end date.

DEPARTMENT.name: course_department
DEPARTMENT.description: Department offering the course, as MIT course number plus name (e.g. '21F - Foreign Languages/Literatures', '18 - Mathematics'); some rows have only the name.

INSTRUCTOR_NAME.name: instructor_name
INSTRUCTOR_NAME.description: Instructor of the course, in 'Last, First' format.

LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY.name: course_instructor_key
LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY.description: Primary key: composite of course number, instructor surname, and term code, plus course number after a colon (e.g. '21F.107-KIDD2011SU:21F.107'). The suffix after the colon can differ from the prefix course number for cross-listed/joint subjects (e.g. '17.100J-PRUITT2009FA:15.678').

UNIT.name: library_unit_name
UNIT.description: MIT library branch holding the course reserves: Hayden, Barker, Dewey, Rotch, or Lewis Music. Null when no unit assignment exists.

UNIT_CODE.name: library_unit_code
UNIT_CODE.description: Code for the library unit; mostly matches UNIT (Hayden) or abbreviations ENG (Barker/engineering), DEW (Dewey), RTC (Rotch), MUS (Lewis Music). Some values combine two units ('Hayden & ENG', 'DEW & Hayden'), suggesting shared reserve assignments; the mapping between UNIT and UNIT_CODE is not fully consistent.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the data warehouse, DD-MON-YY text.

table.name: LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
table.purpose: Lookup table of material status codes for library course reserve materials (e.g., required textbook, reserve-only, no required textbook). Referenced by LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.

LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS.name: material_status_description
LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS.description: Human-readable label of the material status: 'Required Course Material', 'Non-Required Course Material', 'No Required Textbook', 'Reserve only', 'Unknown'. One row (code 'Y') has a null label.

LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE.name: material_status_code
LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE.description: Single-letter code for the material status (U=Unknown, N=Non-Required, R=Required, O=Reserve only, X=No Required Textbook, Y=unlabeled). Duplicates the key column.

LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.name: material_status_key
LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.description: Primary key; single-letter code joined to LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY. Same values as LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (23-DEC-21 for all rows); stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

table.name: LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG
table.purpose: Library catalog records for materials placed on course reserve at the MIT Libraries. Each row is one reserve item's bibliographic record (author, title, call number, ISBN, publisher, year) plus warehouse bookkeeping fields. Rows with null bibliographic fields and year 0 appear to be placeholder/stub records (e.g., cross-listed courses whose readings live elsewhere). Likely the catalog side joined to LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL for reserve transactions.

CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME.name: author_name
CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME.description: Author of the reserve item, in library catalog format (name plus life dates, e.g. 'Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616.'). Null for ~53% of rows, including stub records and items without a personal author.

CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER.name: call_number
CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER.description: Library of Congress call number of the item (e.g. 'QA303.S5547 1996'). Non-LC values appear for non-book media: 'Professor Collection', 'Personal Copy', 'RESERVE VIDEO'.

CATALOG_ISBN.name: isbn
CATALOG_ISBN.description: ISBN of the item, sometimes with qualifiers in MARC style such as '(pbk.)', '(alk. paper)', '(Student text)'.

CATALOG_PUBLISHER.name: publication_statement
CATALOG_PUBLISHER.description: Full MARC-style publication statement: place : publisher, date (e.g. 'New York : McGraw-Hill, 1996.'), not just the publisher name.

CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE.name: catalog_record_create_date
CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE.description: Date the catalog record was created, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. '27-FEB-07').

CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE.name: catalog_record_update_date
CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE.description: Date the catalog record was last updated, DD-MON-YY text format. The dominant value '02-FEB-09' (1686 rows) suggests a bulk update/migration on that date.

CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER.name: catalog_system_number
CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER.description: Bibliographic record identifier from the library catalog system. Identical in distribution to LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY (same values in samples), so it is the source-system ID mirrored as the warehouse key.

CATALOG_TITLE.name: title
CATALOG_TITLE.description: Title (and statement of responsibility) of the reserve item. Some rows instead contain a note that the course is cross-listed and readings are at a URL, indicating placeholder records for cross-listed subjects.

CATALOG_YEAR.name: publication_year
CATALOG_YEAR.description: Year of publication; 0 (2785 rows) means unknown/not applicable, matching the stub records with null bibliographic data. Otherwise values range 1960-2020.

LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY.name: library_reserve_catalog_key
LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY.description: Primary key of the table; equals CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER, the library catalog system's bibliographic record number.

RECORD_COUNTER.name: record_counter
RECORD_COUNTER.description: Constant value 1 on every row; a row-count/ETL bookkeeping field, not meaningful data.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, DD-MON-YY text format. Bulk loads on 13-MAR-08 and 03-FEB-09 account for most rows.

table.name: LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL
table.purpose: Fact/detail table linking library reserve materials (course reserve items) to the course offering, instructor, and term, with a status code indicating whether the material is required for the course. One row per reserve material per course/term instance (MIT course reserve data, ~2008-2011).

LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY.name: LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY.description: Composite key identifying a course-instructor-term instance, of the form '<subject>-<instructor><term>:<subject>'. Joins logically to LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR (no accepted join detected, but the key format matches that table's scope).

LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.name: LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.description: Status of the reserve material relative to the course: U=Unknown, N=Non-Required Course Material, O=Reserve only, X=No Required Textbook, Y=Required Course Material. References LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS.

LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY.name: LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY.description: Identifier of the reserve catalog item (the physical/digital material placed on reserve). References LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG (no accepted join detected, but name and near-unique cardinality per material support this).

LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.name: LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.description: Key of the subject offering: subject ID concatenated with term code (e.g. '21M.2622009FA'). References LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.

TERM_CODE.name: TERM_CODE
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code, e.g. 2009FA (Fall 2009), 2009SP, 2008SU, 2009JA (IAP January). References ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (Oracle DD-MON-YY format); each term's rows were loaded in one batch.

table.name: LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: Library-oriented extract of MIT subject (course) offerings: one row per subject offered per academic term, with subject number, title, offering department/school, responsible faculty member, and enrollment count. Likely used to link library reserve materials to courses/subjects by term. The 'MASTER_*' columns appear to map a subject to its canonical/master subject (e.g., a jointly-listed subject rolled up to a primary subject code).

COURSE_NUMBER.name: offering_department_course_number
COURSE_NUMBER.description: MIT course (department) number of the subject as offered, e.g. '15' = Management, '21F' = Foreign Languages/Literatures. Matches OFFER_DEPT_CODE.

COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: offering_department_name
COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Full name of the offering department corresponding to COURSE_NUMBER.

COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.name: course_number_sort_key
COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.description: COURSE_NUMBER padded with leading spaces for lexicographic sorting.

LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.name: surrogate_primary_key
LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.description: Primary key: concatenation of SUBJECT_ID + TERM_CODE (e.g. '10.543' + '2014SP' = '10.5432014SP').

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.name: master_course_number
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.description: Course/department number of the canonical (master) subject to which this offering rolls up; e.g. subject 10.543 offered by Chemical Engineering maps to master course 7 (Biology). Covers 37 codes vs 16 for COURSE_NUMBER.

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: master_course_number_description
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Full name of the department corresponding to MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.name: master_course_number_sort_key
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.description: MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER padded with leading spaces for lexicographic sorting.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Canonical/master subject number (e.g. '7.88') to which the offered subject maps; used to group cross-listed or jointly-offered subjects.

NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.name: enrollment_count
NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.description: Number of students enrolled in the subject for that term (0-673, median 12).

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: offering_department_code
OFFER_DEPT_CODE.description: Code of the department offering the subject; same values as COURSE_NUMBER (references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE / SIS_SUBJECT_CODE).

OFFER_DEPT_NAME.name: offering_department_name
OFFER_DEPT_NAME.description: Name of the offering department; same as COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.

OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.name: offering_school_name
OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.description: MIT school of the offering department: Hum, Arts & Social Sciences; Engineering; Science; Sloan School of Management; Architecture and Planning.

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.name: responsible_faculty_mit_id
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.description: MIT ID number of the faculty member responsible for the subject offering (9-digit, ~1.1% null).

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.name: responsible_faculty_name
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.description: Name of the responsible faculty member, in 'Last, First' format; null rate matches the MIT ID column.

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: MIT subject number (department.number, e.g. '18.085') as offered in that term.

SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: subject_id_sort_key
SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: SUBJECT_ID padded with leading spaces for lexicographic sorting.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: subject_title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Title of the subject, e.g. 'Real Analysis', 'Calculus'.

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term of the offering in YYYY{FA,SP,SU,JA} format (e.g. 2014FA fall, 2013SP spring, 2013JA January IAP); references ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the data warehouse table was last loaded; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows.

table.name: MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT
table.purpose: Lookup/mapping table of MIT departments, labs, and centers (DLCs): each row is one DLC with its numeric ID, its D_CODE identifier, its name, and the D_CODE, name, and ID of its parent organizational unit (e.g., School of Engineering, VP Research). Used as the parent reference for the master department hierarchy (MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY and related tables). 340 rows, one per DLC, loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24.

DEPT_ID.name: DEPT_ID
DEPT_ID.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for the department/lab/center (DLC). Values are 5-digit integers (11396-16220).

D_CODE.name: D_CODE
D_CODE.description: Unique code identifying the DLC, prefixed 'D_' (e.g., D_TIE, D_WHITEHEAD, D_SCHOOL_ENG). Referenced by many tables as DLC_CODE/DLC_KEY; joins one-to-one to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_CODE.

D_NAME.name: D_NAME
D_NAME.description: Human-readable name of the DLC (e.g., 'Tech. Innovation and Entrepreneurship', 'Whitehead Institute'). Nearly unique; 'MIT Energy Initiative' appears twice (likely two DLC codes sharing a name).

PARENT_D_CODE.name: PARENT_D_CODE
PARENT_D_CODE.description: D_CODE of the parent organizational unit (school, VP area, or administrative area) that this DLC reports to; 31 distinct parents (e.g., D_SCHOOL_ENG = School of Engineering, D_VPRES = VP Research).

PARENT_D_NAME.name: PARENT_D_NAME
PARENT_D_NAME.description: Name of the parent organizational unit, matching PARENT_D_CODE (e.g., 'School of Engineering', 'VP Research').

PARENT_ID.name: PARENT_ID
PARENT_ID.description: Numeric ID (DEPT_ID) of the parent organizational unit; 31 distinct values, consistent with PARENT_D_CODE/PARENT_D_NAME.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' (Oracle DD-MON-YY format) for all rows, indicating a full refresh on that date.

table.name: MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY
table.purpose: Master list of MIT department/lab/center (DLC) codes with their position in the standard administrative hierarchy (All Departments -> Provost/President/EVP area -> school/VP office -> sub-area). One row per DLC code. Referenced by HR, space, facilities, SIS, and finance tables as the canonical DLC lookup.

DLC_CODE.name: DLC code
DLC_CODE.description: Department/Lab/Center code (e.g. D_PSFC, D_MATHS). Identical to DLC_KEY in all rows; joins one-to-one to MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.D_CODE.

DLC_KEY.name: DLC key (primary key)
DLC_KEY.description: Primary key; the DLC code used as foreign key by HR_ORG_UNIT, SIS_DEPARTMENT, SPACE_UNIT, FAC/FCLT_ORGANIZATION, ROLES_FIN_PA, etc. Same values as DLC_CODE.

DLC_NAME.name: DLC name
DLC_NAME.description: Human-readable name of the department/lab/center (e.g. 'Plasma Sciences & Fusion Center', 'Mathematics').

HIERARCHY_TYPE.name: Hierarchy type
HIERARCHY_TYPE.description: Type of hierarchy assignment; constant 'Standard Hierarchy' in all rows.

MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_CODE.name: Hierarchy level 1 code
MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_CODE.description: Top-level hierarchy node code; constant 'D_ALL' (All Departments) for every row.

MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_NAME.name: Hierarchy level 1 name
MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_1_NAME.description: Name of level 1 node; constant 'All Departments'.

MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_CODE.name: Hierarchy level 2 code
MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_CODE.description: Code of the second-level administrative area the DLC belongs to (e.g. D_PROVOST_AREA, D_EXECVP_AREA, D_PRES_AREA); references MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.D_CODE.

MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME.name: Hierarchy level 2 name
