SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: sis_admin_department_code
SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Primary key: administrative department code (e.g. AERO, BE, 21F, 15D). Referenced by SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, STUDENT_DEGREE_PROGRAM, SUBJECT_SUMMARY, and COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.

SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: sis_admin_department_name
SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Human-readable name of the administrative department or office (e.g. 'Biological Engineering Div.', 'Baptist Ministry', 'Benefits Office').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows in this snapshot.

table.name: SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION
table.purpose: MIT Student Information System course/program description dimension: one row per course (department number + option code + level) with its department, school, CIP classification, degree-granting status, default degree, and effective term range (from/thru). Used to describe degree programs and course codes in the SIS warehouse.

CIP_PROGRAM_CODE.name: CIP program code
CIP_PROGRAM_CODE.description: US NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code for the course/program; references CIP.PROGRAM_CODE.

COURSE.name: Course code
COURSE.description: Course/program identifier composed of department number plus an option suffix (e.g. '3 P', 'HST AEM', '22 A'); part of the natural key with COURSE_OPTION and COURSE_LEVEL.

COURSE_DESCRIPTION.name: Course short description
COURSE_DESCRIPTION.description: Short/abbreviated description of the course or degree program (e.g. 'Mat Sci & Eng - M.Eng', 'Linguistics & Philosophy').

COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG.name: Course long description
COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG.description: Full-length description of the course/program, typically the full department or program name (e.g. 'Materials Science and Engineering').

COURSE_LEVEL.name: Course level
COURSE_LEVEL.description: Level of the course/program: 'G' = graduate, 'U' = undergraduate.

COURSE_OPTION.name: Course option code
COURSE_OPTION.description: Option/track code within the course (e.g. 'P', 'AEM', 'NIV' = non-Institute visiting/exchange, 'NIE' = non-Institute exchange). Null when the course has no option; part of the natural key.

DEFAULT_ULTIMATE_DEGREE.name: Default ultimate degree
DEFAULT_ULTIMATE_DEGREE.description: MIT degree abbreviation set as the default ultimate degree for the program: NDG = no degree, SM = Master of Science, SB = Bachelor of Science, DOC = doctorate, MNG = Master of Engineering, plus others (MBA, MCP, HA).

DEPARTMENT.name: Department code
DEPARTMENT.description: MIT department code (numeric course number like '3', '15', or program code like 'HST', 'NIV'); references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Short name of the department/program corresponding to DEPARTMENT (e.g. 'Materials Science and Eng', 'Linguistics and Philosophy').

DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: Department name in commencement book
DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Formal department name as printed in the commencement program book (e.g. 'Department of Materials Science and Engineering'); null when not applicable.

FROM_TERM.name: Effective from term
FROM_TERM.description: Academic term code (e.g. '2001FA', '2015JA') from which this course description is effective; '000000' means 'Beginning of Time'. References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: From term description
FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable description of FROM_TERM (e.g. 'Fall Term 2000-2001', 'Beginning of Time').

GRADAUTE_LEVEL.name: Graduate level (misspelled)
GRADAUTE_LEVEL.description: Graduate degree level: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral'; null for undergraduate/non-degree rows. Appears to be a duplicate of GRADUATE_LEVEL (misspelled column name).

GRADUATE_LEVEL.name: Graduate level
GRADUATE_LEVEL.description: Graduate degree level: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral'; null for undergraduate/non-degree rows. Duplicate of GRADAUTE_LEVEL.

IS_DEGREE_GRANTING.name: Is degree granting
IS_DEGREE_GRANTING.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the course/program grants a degree.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: Last activity date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the record was last updated in the source system, in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. '23-JUL-15').

SCHOOL_NAME.name: School name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Abbreviated MIT school the course belongs to (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Science', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Non-MIT').

SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: School name in commencement book
SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Formal school name as printed in the commencement book (e.g. 'School of Engineering'); null when not applicable.

SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY.name: Surrogate/natural key
SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY.description: Primary key: concatenation of COURSE ':' COURSE_OPTION ':' COURSE_LEVEL (option omitted when null), e.g. '3:P:G', '24::G'.

THRU_TERM.name: Effective through term
THRU_TERM.description: Academic term code through which this course description is effective; '999999' means 'End of Time' (currently active). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

THRU_TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: Through term description
THRU_TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable description of THRU_TERM (e.g. 'Fall Term 2003-2004', 'End of Time').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this extract.

table.name: SIS_DEPARTMENT
table.purpose: MIT Student Information System department reference table: one row per academic/administrative department (course number or program code), with its name, school, degree-granting flag, budget code, DLC key, and commencement program naming. Referenced by student and subject tables via DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Short department/course code (MIT course number like '1', '21F', or program code like 'HASS', 'ODGE', 'NIV'). Not unique here (127 distinct over 128 rows, one null), so not a strict primary key.

DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.name: department_full_name
DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.description: Canonical department identifier: code + '-' + name (e.g. 'HASS-HASS Office...'). Unique across rows; used as join key by STUDENT_DEPARTMENT and SUBJECT_GROUPING.

DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: department_last_activity_date
DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date of last recorded activity/change for the department record, in Oracle DD-MON-YY format. Many rows share 17-FEB-94, likely a bulk load/initial entry date.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Human-readable department name without the code prefix (e.g. 'History', 'Anthropology').

DEPARTMENT_NAME_HISTORY.name: department_name_history
DEPARTMENT_NAME_HISTORY.description: Notes on prior names or reorganizations of the department (e.g. 'was BEH', 'Anthropol/Archaeol until 1998-99'). Sparse (90% null).

DEPT_BUDGET_CODE.name: dept_budget_code
DEPT_BUDGET_CODE.description: Numeric budget/accounting code assigned to the department (values 30000-446900). ~30% null; exact financial system it maps to is unresolved.

DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: dept_name_in_commencement_book
DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Department name as printed in the commencement program book (formal names like 'Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics'). Null when not applicable.

DLC_KEY.name: dlc_key
DLC_KEY.description: Key to the DLC (Department, Lab, or Center) hierarchy; joins to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY / MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT. Values like 'D_DHSS', 'D_CROSS_REG'.

IS_DEGREE_GRANTING.name: is_degree_granting
IS_DEGREE_GRANTING.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the department grants degrees.

SCHOOL_CODE.name: school_code
SCHOOL_CODE.description: Single-letter code of the MIT school the department belongs to (E=Engineering, H=Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, Y=MIT academic, Z=Non-MIT, X=MIT non-academic, etc.).

SCHOOL_NAME.name: school_name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Name of the school corresponding to SCHOOL_CODE (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Non-MIT').

SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: school_name_in_commencement_book
SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Formal school name as printed in the commencement program book (e.g. 'School of Engineering'). Null when not applicable.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows.

table.name: SIS_LOOKUP
table.purpose: Generic code-description lookup table for the Student Information System (SIS), holding code/label pairs for several categories of student registration and enrollment codes (registration status, enrollment status, load level, registration group, registration type). Each row is one code within one lookup category; the pair (LOOKUP_TYPE, CODE) identifies a row. 67 rows, loaded once on 19-DEC-24, so it appears to be a static reference snapshot rather than an event table. The '?' descriptions and 3% null CODEs suggest incomplete source documentation in the upstream SIS.

CODE.name: code
CODE.description: Short alphanumeric code (1-2 chars) whose meaning is given by DESCRIPTION, interpreted within the LOOKUP_TYPE category. Examples: RE = Registered (enrollment status), N = New Regular Grad Student (registration group), PR/NE/RX/DH/CN etc. are other SIS codes. Not unique on its own; unique only within a LOOKUP_TYPE. ~3% null, meaning unknown.

DESCRIPTION.name: description
DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable label for the code, e.g. 'Registered', 'Dropped, No Tuition', 'Not for graduate credit', '3/4 Time', 'Listener', 'Degree Held Previously'. A few rows have '?' where the meaning was not documented.

LOOKUP_TYPE.name: lookup_type
LOOKUP_TYPE.description: Category of the lookup: 'Registration Status' (23), 'Enrollment Status' (21), 'Load Level' (8), 'Registration Group' (8), 'Registration Type' (4), plus one undocumented value 'HGN' (likely a category code whose label was not resolved). Together with CODE it forms the logical key of the table.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; all rows show '19-DEC-24' (stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format), indicating a single bulk load. Not a business attribute of the lookup itself.

table.name: SIS_SUBJECT_CODE
table.purpose: MIT SIS lookup table of subject (course) codes: each row is one subject code (e.g. '11', '21F', 'MCI') with its owning department and school, plus a descriptive title. Referenced by course-offering tables (SUBJECT_OFFERED, LIBRARY/TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, etc.).

COURSE_NUMBER.name: subject_code
COURSE_NUMBER.description: MIT subject/course code (e.g. '11', '21F', 'MCI'); primary key of this lookup table, identical in values to SUBJECT_CODE.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Code of the MIT department offering subjects under this code; references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE (e.g. '11' = Urban Studies and Planning, 'NIW' = Wellesley Cross-Enrollment). Null for ~14% of rows.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Full name of the owning department (e.g. 'Urban Studies and Planning', 'Non-Institute-MFA/MCA'); denormalized label for DEPARTMENT_CODE.

SCHOOL_CODE.name: school_code
SCHOOL_CODE.description: Code of the MIT school the department belongs to ('Z' = Non-MIT, 'E' = Engineering, 'H' = Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, 'A' = Architecture and Planning, 'S' = Science, etc.).

SCHOOL_NAME.name: school_name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Full name of the school corresponding to SCHOOL_CODE (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Non-MIT', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences').

SUBJECT_CODE.name: subject_code
SUBJECT_CODE.description: MIT subject/course code; duplicate of COURSE_NUMBER (same values, both unique). Used as the join key by other tables.

SUBJECT_CODE_DESC.name: subject_code_description
SUBJECT_CODE_DESC.description: Descriptive title of the subject code (e.g. 'Urban Studies and Planning', 'Studio for Interrelated Media'); for cross-enrollment codes often notes the partner school or 'old' retired codes.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load timestamp of the row into the warehouse, stored as text ('19-DEC-24'); constant across all rows in this snapshot.

table.name: SIS_TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY
table.purpose: Lookup table from MIT's Student Information System mapping term-time address category codes (dormitories, fraternities, sororities, ILGs, off-campus) to their names and living-group types, with validity date ranges and warehouse audit dates. One row per address category code.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the record was last updated in the source system, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format.

LIVING_GROUP_TYPE.name: living_group_type_code
LIVING_GROUP_TYPE.description: Single-letter code for the type of living group: D=Dormitory, F=Fraternity, S=Sorority, I=ILG (Independent Living Group), O=Off Campus. Nulls correspond to 'Unknown' in the description column.

LIVING_GROUP_TYPE_DESC.name: living_group_type_description
LIVING_GROUP_TYPE_DESC.description: Human-readable label for LIVING_GROUP_TYPE: Dormitory, Fraternity, Sorority, ILG, Off Campus, Unknown.

TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY.name: term_address_category_name
TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY.description: Name/label of the term-time address category, e.g. dormitory names (Westgate Lowrise, Graduate Junction), fraternity/sorority names (Alpha Phi, Kappa Sigma), or street addresses (405 Memorial Dr).

TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY_CODE.name: term_address_category_code
TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY_CODE.description: Primary key: short code identifying the term address category (e.g. PKA=pika, WGA=Westgate, GJA=Graduate Junction); some rows use numeric codes.

VALID_FROM_DATE.name: valid_from_date
VALID_FROM_DATE.description: Date the category became valid, as DD-MON-YY text; 01-JAN-60 is a default/earliest-possible date.

VALID_THRU_DATE.name: valid_thru_date
VALID_THRU_DATE.description: Date the category ceased to be valid, as DD-MON-YY text; null means still active.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (19-DEC-24 for all rows, i.e. the latest full load).

table.name: SPACE_DETAIL
table.purpose: Room-level space inventory: one row per room (or room subdivision) in a building, with its floor, room number, square footage, assigned organizational space unit, and space usage classification. Appears to be a data-warehouse detail table over the FCLT/FAC rooms data (MIT-style building-room numbering, e.g. 32-276).

BUILDING_COMPONENT.name: building_number
BUILDING_COMPONENT.description: Building number (MIT-style numeric building code, e.g. 10, 13, 32; some variants like '42T'). References FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER.

BUILDING_KEY.name: building_number
BUILDING_KEY.description: Building number, same values as BUILDING_COMPONENT (numeric form). The statistical join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is spurious; the real referent is the building tables.

BUILDING_ROOM.name: building_room
BUILDING_ROOM.description: Full room identifier combining building number and room number, e.g. '32-276'.

BUILDING_ROOM_NAME.name: building_room_name
BUILDING_ROOM_NAME.description: Duplicate of BUILDING_ROOM (identical values); presumably a name/label field that carries the same building-room code.

FLOOR_KEY.name: floor_key
FLOOR_KEY.description: Floor within the building: numeric floors ('0'-'4'...) plus basement/sublevel codes like 'D6', 'G6'. References SPACE_FLOOR.FLOOR_KEY.

ROOM_COUNTER.name: room_counter
ROOM_COUNTER.description: Constant value 1 on every row; likely a row counter used for counting rooms (sum = number of rooms).

ROOM_NUMBER.name: room_number
ROOM_NUMBER.description: Room number within the building (suffix of BUILDING_ROOM), including letter suffixes like '82B', '36E'.

ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.name: room_square_footage
ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.description: Area of the room in square feet (1 to ~108,475; median 147).

SPACE_UNIT_KEY.name: space_unit_key
SPACE_UNIT_KEY.description: Key of the organizational unit (department/DLC) occupying or responsible for the room; references SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY / SPACE_UNIT_CODE.

SPACE_USAGE_KEY.name: space_usage_key
SPACE_USAGE_KEY.description: Usage classification code for the room (e.g. 38=CLNT MEETING ROOM, 46=MED ROOM, 71=DINING RM, 87=LIBRARY); references SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: SPACE_FLOOR
table.purpose: A small lookup/dimension table of floor codes used in MIT space and facilities data. Each row is one floor level (numeric floors plus basement/sub-level codes like D4, D6, G9). Other tables (SPACE_DETAIL, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD) reference it to identify a room's floor. Likely a warehouse-local copy or view derived from FCLT_FLOOR/FAC_FLOOR, given the load date column.

FLOOR.name: Floor code
FLOOR.description: Floor identifier code: numeric strings for above-ground floors ('1', '17', '29') and coded values such as 'D6', 'G9' presumably for basement/sub-levels. Duplicates FLOOR_KEY; referenced by room-level tables (FCLT_ROOMS_HIST.FLOOR, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.FLOOR, SPACE_DETAIL.FLOOR_KEY).

FLOOR_KEY.name: Floor code (primary key)
FLOOR_KEY.description: Primary key of the lookup: the floor code itself ('0', '00', '000', '0000', '1', ..., 'D6', '17'). Joined to by SPACE_DETAIL.FLOOR_KEY, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST.FLOOR and ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.FLOOR to resolve a room's floor.

FLOOR_NAME.name: Floor display name
FLOOR_NAME.description: Human-readable label formed by appending ' Floor' to the floor code, e.g. '27 Floor', 'D4 Floor'. Purely derived from FLOOR/FLOOR_KEY.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; all rows show '19-DEC-24' (Oracle-style DD-MON-YY), indicating a single full load/refresh on 2019? no — December 19, 2024. Not a business attribute of the floor.

table.name: SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE
table.purpose: Per-person (supervisor) space and research volume metrics at MIT: for each employee identified by MIT_ID, the square footage of space attributed to them, their research volume (likely dollars of research/administrative activity), the number of departments and supervisees associated with them, and derived ratios. Likely used for space-charge or space-planning analysis, allocating space usage to supervisors.

DEPT_COUNT.name: DEPT_COUNT
DEPT_COUNT.description: Number of departments the supervisor is associated with; equals the count of comma-separated codes in DEPT_NAMES (1-4, overwhelmingly 1).

DEPT_NAMES.name: DEPT_NAMES
DEPT_NAMES.description: Comma-separated MIT department DLC codes (e.g. D_LIBRARIES, D_SLOAN, D_EAPS) the supervisor belongs to; count matches DEPT_COUNT.

MIT_ID.name: MIT_ID
MIT_ID.description: MIT personal identifier of the employee/supervisor; unique per row (primary key).

NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES.name: NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES.description: Number of people this employee supervises (direct reports), 1 to 121, median 1.

RESEARCH_VOLUME.name: RESEARCH_VOLUME
RESEARCH_VOLUME.description: Research volume attributed to the supervisor, presumably in dollars (values up to ~9.5M, some negative, likely adjustments/credits); zero for ~70% of rows.

RES_VOL_PER_SQFT.name: RES_VOL_PER_SQFT
RES_VOL_PER_SQFT.description: Research volume per square foot (RESEARCH_VOLUME / SQFT), rounded; zero when either input is zero.

SQFT.name: SQFT
SQFT.description: Square footage of space attributed to the supervisor; 0 for 248 rows (no assigned space).

SQFT_PER_SUPERVISEE.name: SQFT_PER_SUPERVISEE
SQFT_PER_SUPERVISEE.description: Square footage per supervisee (SQFT / NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES); equals SQFT when there is one supervisee.

table.name: SPACE_UNIT
table.purpose: Space-occupying organizational units at MIT (departments, labs, centers, offices) that can be assigned space; maps DLC (department/lab/center) codes to facility organization keys and HR department codes used by the space and facilities systems.

DLC_KEY.name: DLC key
DLC_KEY.description: Code identifying the department, lab, or center (DLC), prefixed 'D_' (e.g. D_MECHE = Mechanical Engineering, D_DUSP = Urban Studies). References MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY. Null where the space unit has no DLC mapping.

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: Facilities organization key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Surrogate key of the corresponding organization record in the facilities system (FAC_ORGANIZATION / FCLT_ORGANIZATION). Unique per row; referenced by FCLT_ROOMS and FCLT_ROOMS_HIST.

SPACE_UNIT.name: Space unit name
SPACE_UNIT.description: Human-readable name of the space-occupying unit (department, lab, center, or office), e.g. 'Mechanical Engineering', 'List Visual Arts Center'. Nulls align with DLC_KEY nulls.

SPACE_UNIT_CODE.name: Space unit code (HR department code)
SPACE_UNIT_CODE.description: Numeric code of the space unit, identical to SPACE_UNIT_KEY; matches HR department codes (HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD / ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) in the facilities organization tables and is referenced by room/space tables.

SPACE_UNIT_KEY.name: Space unit key
SPACE_UNIT_KEY.description: Primary key of the table; numeric identifier of the space unit, same value as SPACE_UNIT_CODE. Referenced by SPACE_DETAIL, SPACE_UNIT2, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD and facilities organization tables.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load timestamp of the row into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: SPACE_UNIT2
table.purpose: Crosswalk mapping MIT space/occupancy units (departments, labs, and centers) to their DLC (Department, Lab, or Center) keys, with unit codes/keys matching the SPACE_UNIT table. Appears to be a secondary or derived version of SPACE_UNIT keyed by DLC.

DLC_KEY.name: DLC key
DLC_KEY.description: Identifier of the Department, Lab, or Center (DLC) that owns or occupies the space unit, e.g. D_MECHE (Mechanical Engineering), D_NUCENG (Nuclear Engineering), D_CHANCELLOR. References MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY. Nulls (~5%) likely indicate units with no assigned DLC.

SPACE_UNIT.name: Space unit name
SPACE_UNIT.description: Name of the space/occupancy unit (department, lab, center, or facility), e.g. 'LITERATURE', 'MCGOVERN INSTITUTE', 'ENDICOTT HOUSE'. Matches FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME.

SPACE_UNIT_CODE.name: Space unit code
SPACE_UNIT_CODE.description: Numeric code identifying the space unit; same values as SPACE_UNIT_KEY and joins to SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE / SPACE_UNIT_KEY. Not unique here (some units appear twice, likely one row per DLC assignment).

SPACE_UNIT_KEY.name: Space unit key
SPACE_UNIT_KEY.description: Duplicate of SPACE_UNIT_CODE; the key of the unit in the SPACE_UNIT table.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a full refresh on that date.

table.name: SPACE_USAGE
table.purpose: Lookup table of space/room usage category codes (e.g., research room, design studio, dining room) used to classify rooms in the facilities space data warehouse; referenced by SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY.

SPACE_USAGE.name: space_usage_label
SPACE_USAGE.description: Short label describing the room/space usage category, abbreviated (RM = room, TRNG = training, RSRC = resource, DSGN = design, CLNT = client, MED = medical). 50 distinct categories across 88 rows, so labels repeat with different keys (likely versioned or duplicated entries).

SPACE_USAGE_KEY.name: space_usage_key
SPACE_USAGE_KEY.description: Surrogate primary key (1-88, unique) identifying each space usage category row; the meaningful join is to SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY. The many other statistical 'joins' to unrelated integer columns are spurious numeric coincidences.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' (Dec 19, 2024) for all rows in this snapshot.

table.name: STUDENT_DEGREE_PROGRAM
table.purpose: Reference/dimension table of MIT degree programs: one row per degree-program offering (degree type + course/department combination), with descriptions, commencement program book labels, and effective term ranges. Not per-student records despite the name; it catalogs the degree programs students can earn.

COMMENCEMENT_BK_COURSE_ROMAN.name: Commencement program book course (Roman numeral)
COMMENCEMENT_BK_COURSE_ROMAN.description: How the course/department is rendered in the commencement program book, using MIT's traditional Roman-numeral course numbering (e.g. Course XII, Course VI-P, Course FIRST YEAR).

COMMENCEMENT_BK_SEE_ALSO.name: Commencement program book cross-reference
COMMENCEMENT_BK_SEE_ALSO.description: Alternate/cross-listed label in the commencement program book, typically degree abbreviation plus course or special program (e.g. 'S.M., W.H.O.I.', 'Ph.D., Course VII').

COURSE.name: MIT course number
COURSE.description: MIT course number identifying the degree program's course/curriculum (e.g. '2' Mechanical Engineering, '6' EECS, '21W'); may include a suffix for a variant or second component (e.g. '2 M', '10 B', 'SCM 2B').

COURSE_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: Course last activity date
COURSE_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last recorded activity/change for this course/program record; an audit timestamp, not a student event.

COURSE_LEVEL.name: Course level
COURSE_LEVEL.description: Level of the degree program: 'G' = graduate, 'U' = undergraduate.

DEGREE_CODE.name: Degree program code
DEGREE_CODE.description: Opaque code identifying the specific degree program, combining degree type and course/field (e.g. PHD, SMWS12, SB10B).

DEGREE_DESC.name: Degree description (long)
DEGREE_DESC.description: Full official name of the degree program, e.g. 'Doctor of Philosophy', 'Bachelor of Science in Chemical-Biological Engineering'.

DEGREE_DESC_SHORT.name: Degree description (short)
DEGREE_DESC_SHORT.description: Abbreviated degree program name, e.g. 'Master of Science (w/o spec of field, recommended by Mechanical Engineering)'.

DEGREE_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: Degree last activity date
DEGREE_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last recorded activity/change for this degree record; an audit timestamp.

DEGREE_TYPE.name: Degree type code
DEGREE_TYPE.description: Abbreviation of the degree level: SM (Master of Science), SB (Bachelor of Science), PHD, SCD, ENG, MCP, MBA, etc.

DEGREE_TYPE_DESC.name: Degree type description
DEGREE_TYPE_DESC.description: Full name corresponding to DEGREE_TYPE, e.g. 'Master of Science', 'Doctor of Philosophy'.

DEGREE_WEIGHT.name: Degree weight
DEGREE_WEIGHT.description: Numeric weight/rank associated with the degree type (SB=1, SM=3, ENG=6, PHD/SCD=8, etc.), likely used for ordering or counting degrees by level. The detected join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (coincidental value overlap).

DEPARTMENT.name: Department code
DEPARTMENT.description: MIT department number/code administering the degree program (e.g. '12' = Earth, Atmospheric & Planetary Sciences, '15' = Management); joins to STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE.

DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: Department name in commencement program book
DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Department name as printed in the commencement program book (e.g. 'Department of Mechanical Engineering', 'Sloan School of Management').

FROM_TERM.name: Effective from term
FROM_TERM.description: Academic term code (e.g. 1985SP, 2009FA) from which this degree program is/was offered; '000000' indicates no start term recorded (open-ended/legacy). Joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

IS_DOUBLE_MAJOR.name: Is double major flag
IS_DOUBLE_MAJOR.description: 'Y' if the degree program counts as a double major, 'N' otherwise.

SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: School name in commencement program book
SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: MIT school the program belongs to, as printed in the commencement book (School of Engineering, School of Science, Sloan, etc.).

THRU_TERM.name: Effective through term
THRU_TERM.description: Academic term code through which the degree program was offered; '999999' indicates still active/open-ended. Joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this extract.

table.name: STUDENT_DEPARTMENT
table.purpose: Lookup table of MIT academic departments (79 rows), keyed by department code, with the department's full name, short name, and the school (e.g. Engineering, Science, Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences) it belongs to. Includes non-MIT/cross-enrollment pseudo-departments. Referenced by student, course, and subject tables for department codes.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: Department code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Primary key. MIT course/department code: numeric for academic departments (1 = Civil and Environmental Engineering, 12 = EAPS, 21L = Literature), alphabetic for special programs (NIT = Tufts Cross-Enrollment, CDO, WCD, NIV, UND).

DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.name: Department full name (code + name)
DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.description: Department code concatenated with the department name, e.g. '12-Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci'. Matches SIS_DEPARTMENT one-to-one.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Human-readable department/program name without the code prefix. 'Biological Engineering' appears twice (two codes, e.g. 20 and BE).

SCHOOL_CODE.name: School code
SCHOOL_CODE.description: One-letter code for the school/college grouping the department belongs to: E = Engineering, H = Humanities, Arts & Social Sciences, S = Science, Z = Non-MIT, Y = MIT academic, T, W (Whitaker/HST), etc. Exact mapping for all 9 codes not fully evidenced.

SCHOOL_NAME.name: School name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Name of the school/college the department belongs to (Engineering; Science; Hum, Arts & Social Sciences; Non-MIT; Schwarzman College of Computing; Whitaker College of HST).

table.name: STUDENT_ETHNIC_SUBGROUP
table.purpose: A lookup/dimension table mapping federal ethnic/race group codes to finer-grained ethnic subgroups (e.g. Asian -> China, Hispanic -> Puerto Rico) used for student demographic reporting. One row per ethnic subgroup within a group; the primary key concatenates group code and subgroup code. The join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap), not a real relationship.

ETHNIC_CODE.name: ethnic_group_code
ETHNIC_CODE.description: Two-digit code for the broad ethnic/racial group (10=Black or African American, 20=American Indian or Alaskan Native, 30=Hispanic or Latino?, 40=Hispanic or Latino, 50=Asian, etc.). The first two digits of ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is coincidental numeric overlap, not a real reference.

ETHNIC_GROUP_NAME.name: ethnic_group_name
ETHNIC_GROUP_NAME.description: Human-readable name of the broad ethnic/racial group corresponding to ETHNIC_CODE (e.g. 'Asian', 'Hispanic or Latino', 'Black or African American').

ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE.name: ethnic_subgroup_code
ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE.description: Four-digit code for the specific ethnic subgroup; first two digits equal the group's ETHNIC_CODE (e.g. 5001 = Asian/China). Unique within the table. The join to CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.ACADEMIC_YEAR is coincidental, not a real reference.

ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_NAME.name: ethnic_subgroup_name
ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_NAME.description: Name of the specific ethnic subgroup, e.g. 'China', 'Puerto Rico', 'Sioux', 'African American', 'Europe'. 'Other' appears multiple times (once per group), which is why distinct count (42) is below row count (46).

STUDENT_ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_KEY.name: student_ethnic_subgroup_key
STUDENT_ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_KEY.description: Primary key: concatenation of ETHNIC_CODE and ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE as 'group:subgroup' (e.g. '50:5001').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a single full load.

table.name: SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE
table.purpose: Lookup table of subject (course) attribute codes used in MIT's course catalog (e.g., HASS, GIR, communication requirement, tuition, institute lab, language codes). One row per attribute code; referenced by course catalog tables to classify subjects. 104 rows, one per code.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the attribute record was last updated/modified, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format. Values span 1993-2022.

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.name: subject_attribute_code
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.description: Primary key. Code identifying a subject attribute (e.g., HASS, GIR, communication requirement, tuition, institute lab, language codes like BIOL, CAL1, Z8). Referenced by TUITION_ATTRIBUTE, GIR_ATTRIBUTE, COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE, WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE, SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE columns in course catalog tables.

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: subject_attribute_description
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Full description of the attribute code (e.g., 'HUM-D, Film and Media Studies', 'Biology', 'Comm Reqt - Expository Writing').

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_REPORT_DESC.name: subject_attribute_report_description
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_REPORT_DESC.description: Short label used for reporting, populated only for Humanities Distribution (HUM-D) attributes (HD-1..HD-5, HD-L, LINKED). Null for 91% of rows.

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_SHORT_DESC.name: subject_attribute_short_description
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_SHORT_DESC.description: Abbreviated description of the attribute (e.g., 'HASS-A', 'Half Inst Lab', 'Sloan Core'). Null for ~39% of rows.

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE.name: subject_attribute_type
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE.description: Flag distinguishing attribute categories: 'A' (94 rows, academic/requirement attributes like HASS, GIR, labs) vs 'N' (10 rows). The exact meaning of 'N' is unresolved; possibly non-academic/administrative attributes.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (DD-MON-YY text); constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a full snapshot load.

table.name: SUBJECT_ENROLLABLE
table.purpose: One row per subject (course) per academic term that was open for enrollment, with the subject grouped under a master/cluster subject. All rows here belong to a single master subject cluster (HAA.0000, Harvard Art History-related subjects) offered by one department (NIH) across terms 2011SP–2013FA. Likely a Harvard (HAA = Harvard Art & Architecture?) course enrollment extract loaded into a warehouse on 19-DEC-24; the exact institutional meaning of the cluster is tentative.

CLUSTER_LIST.name: cluster_subject_id_list
CLUSTER_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs belonging to the same master-subject cluster as this row's subject. The list varies slightly by term, reflecting which subjects were grouped together that term.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the master (parent) subject under which this subject is grouped. Constant 'HAA.0000' in this extract, matching the first entry of CLUSTER_LIST.

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: offering_department_code
OFFER_DEPT_CODE.description: Code of the department offering the subject; constant 'NIH' in this extract. The exact department it stands for is unresolved (no join evidence).

OFFER_SCHOOL_CODE.name: offering_school_code
OFFER_SCHOOL_CODE.description: Code of the school offering the subject; constant 'Z' in this extract. Meaning of 'Z' is unresolved (no join evidence).

SUBJECT_GROUP_ID.name: subject_group_id
SUBJECT_GROUP_ID.description: Opaque surrogate key identifying the subject group (subject + term combination); one distinct value per term, matching TERM_CODE counts exactly. Likely a join key to a subject-grouping table, but no accepted join was detected.

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the individual subject (course), e.g. HAA.3405. Repeats up to 5 times, once per term in the extract.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: subject_title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Short title of the subject, often including course number and abbreviated name (e.g. 'VES 50: Filmmaking').

SUBJECT_TITLE_LONG.name: subject_title_long
SUBJECT_TITLE_LONG.description: Long title of the subject; in this data identical to SUBJECT_TITLE for every row, so no distinct 'long' form is present.

TERM_CODE.name: academic_term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term in which the subject was enrollable, format YYYY + FA/SP (e.g. 2012FA = Fall 2012). References ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: ultimate_master_subject_id
ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the top-level master subject in the grouping hierarchy; constant 'HAA.0000' here, same as MASTER_SUBJECT_ID (no intermediate levels in this extract).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' (Oracle DD-MON-YY format) for this extract.

table.name: SUBJECT_GROUPING
table.purpose: Maps MIT academic departments (code, name, school) to academic terms, one row per department-term combination, likely used to group or classify subjects offered in each term. The surrogate key and warehouse load date indicate this is a data-warehouse dimension/bridge table refreshed in bulk.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: MIT department code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Short code identifying the academic department or program (e.g. '2' = Mechanical Engineering, '4' = Architecture, 'MAS' = Media Arts and Sciences). Matches the code prefix in DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.

DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.name: Department code and full name
DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.description: Concatenation of department code and department name (e.g. '2-Mechanical Engineering'). Joins to SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Human-readable department/program name without the code prefix (e.g. 'Mechanical Engineering').

SCHOOL_NAME.name: School name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: The MIT school the department belongs to (Engineering; Humanities, Arts & Social Sciences; Science; Architecture and Planning; Sloan School of Management; plus special values like 'Non-MIT' and 'MIT, non-academic').

SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.name: Subject grouping surrogate key
SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.description: Primary key; a warehouse-generated surrogate key (mostly hex hashes, some legacy values like '1994SP66.196'). Uniquely identifies a department-term grouping row.

TERM_CODE.name: Academic term code
TERM_CODE.description: Term in the format YYYY + session code: FA = fall, SP = spring, SU = summer, JA = January/IAP (e.g. '2008SU', '2022SP'). Joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows, indicating a full refresh on that date.

table.name: SUBJECT_IAP_SCHEDULE
table.purpose: Meeting schedule for MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) January 2021 non-credit activities/subjects: for each session, its date, start/end time, location (mostly virtual/Zoom), and remarks such as registration or Zoom links. Likely related to IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION/IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL, though no join keys are populated in this snapshot.

IAP_DATE.name: meeting_date
IAP_DATE.description: Date of the IAP session, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 14-JAN-21). All dates fall in January 2021, consistent with IAP.

MEET_END_TIME.name: meeting_end_time
MEET_END_TIME.description: End time of the session as text in HHMMPM format (e.g., 0300PM = 3:00 PM).

MEET_PLACE.name: meeting_location
MEET_PLACE.description: Location of the session; in this COVID-era snapshot almost entirely virtual (Zoom, Virtual, Online, with various capitalizations and free-text variants).

MEET_START_TIME.name: meeting_start_time
MEET_START_TIME.description: Start time of the session as text in HHMMPM format (e.g., 0100PM = 1:00 PM).

REMARKS.name: remarks
REMARKS.description: Free-text notes about the session, mostly registration instructions and Zoom meeting links/IDs.

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code for the schedule; single value 2021JA = January/IAP term of academic year 2021. Likely joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS-style term code, though no join was detected.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the warehouse (19-DEC-24 for all rows), not a business date.

table.name: SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: One row per subject offering (course section) per term, for Harvard Arts and Sciences (HAA) cross-enrollment courses offered to MIT students via the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program. Each row is a master-section offering of a Harvard course in a given term (JA = January/Spring, SU = Summer), with flags describing section type, graduate-credit eligibility, and cluster grouping. All rows in this extract are HAA master sections with zero enrollment recorded in this warehouse table.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Cluster enrollment number
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Enrollment number for the subject cluster; always 0 in this extract, so the exact semantics (enrollment count of the cluster of related subjects) is plausible but unverified.

CLUSTER_LIST.name: Cluster subject list
CLUSTER_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs (HAA.xxxx) belonging to the same cluster/grouping of related subjects, prefixed by the master subject HAA.0000.

CLUSTER_TYPE.name: Cluster type code
CLUSTER_TYPE.description: Code for the cluster type; 'S' in all rows, meaning School-Wide Electives (per CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC).

CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.name: Cluster type description
CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.description: Description of CLUSTER_TYPE; 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' in all rows.

COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY.name: Composite subject key
COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY.description: Key of the composite/master subject (HAA.0000) plus term code, e.g. HAA.00002014JA; identifies the cluster's master offering per term.

COURSE_NUMBER.name: Course (subject code) number
COURSE_NUMBER.description: Course/subject code prefix; 'HAA' = Harvard, Arts and Sciences in all rows.

COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: Course number description
COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Description of COURSE_NUMBER; 'Harvard, Arts and Sciences'.

COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.name: Course number sort key
COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.description: Sort-friendly version of COURSE_NUMBER; identical to COURSE_NUMBER here.

EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT.name: Evaluate this subject flag
EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the subject is subject to student evaluation; always 'N' in this extract.

HGN_CODE.name: Harvard graduate credit code
HGN_CODE.description: Code indicating graduate-credit status: N = Not for graduate credit, G = Graduate program, H = Higher level graduate program. Joins to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

HGN_CODE_DESC.name: HGN code description
HGN_CODE_DESC.description: Description of HGN_CODE (e.g. 'Not for graduate credit').

IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE.name: Created by data warehouse flag
IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the row was synthesized by the data warehouse rather than the source system; always 'N'.

IS_DESIGN_SECTION.name: Is design section flag
IS_DESIGN_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a design section; always 'N'.

IS_LAB_SECTION.name: Is lab section flag
IS_LAB_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a lab section; always 'N'.

IS_LECTURE_SECTION.name: Is lecture section flag
IS_LECTURE_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a lecture section; always 'N'.

IS_MASTER_SECTION.name: Is master section flag
IS_MASTER_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this row is the master (top-level) section of the subject; always 'Y' in this extract.

IS_OSE_SUBJECT.name: Is OSE subject flag
IS_OSE_SUBJECT.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the subject is an OSE subject (likely 'Offered by Someone Else' / external-offering designation); always 'N'. Exact expansion of OSE is not evidenced.

IS_RECITATION_SECTION.name: Is recitation section flag
IS_RECITATION_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a recitation section; always 'N'.

IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT.name: Is repeatable subject flag
IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the subject can be taken repeatedly for credit; always 'N'.

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.name: Master course number
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.description: Course number of the master subject of the cluster; 'HAA' in all rows.

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: Master course number description
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Description of MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER; 'Harvard, Arts and Sciences'.

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.name: Master course number sort key
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.description: Sort-friendly version of MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER; identical here.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Master subject ID
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID of the cluster's master/composite subject; 'HAA.0000' in all rows.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: Master subject ID sort key
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: Sort-friendly version of MASTER_SUBJECT_ID; identical here.

MASTER_SUBJECT_KEY.name: Master subject key
MASTER_SUBJECT_KEY.description: Warehouse key for the master subject offering: master subject ID concatenated with term code, e.g. HAA00000002014JA.

NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.name: Number of enrolled students
NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.description: Count of enrolled students for the offering; always 0 in this extract (enrollment counts likely tracked elsewhere, e.g. SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY).

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: Offering department code
OFFER_DEPT_CODE.description: Code of the department offering the subject; 'NIH' = Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program (per OFFER_DEPT_NAME).

OFFER_DEPT_NAME.name: Offering department name
OFFER_DEPT_NAME.description: Name of the offering department; 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' in all rows.

OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.name: Offering school name
OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.description: School offering the subject; 'Non-MIT' in all rows, consistent with Harvard cross-enrollment courses.

SECTION_ID.name: Section ID
SECTION_ID.description: Identifier of the section within the subject; always '0', consistent with all rows being master sections.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Subject enrollment number
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Enrollment number for the subject offering; always 0 in this extract.

SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.name: Subject grouping key
SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.description: Opaque surrogate key identifying the subject grouping/cluster the offering belongs to; one value per master subject + term, matching COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY cardinality.

SUBJECT_ID.name: Subject ID
SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the subject (course) within the HAA course number, e.g. HAA.5243; 2081 distinct Harvard courses.

SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: Subject ID sort key
SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: Sort-friendly version of SUBJECT_ID; identical to SUBJECT_ID here.

SUBJECT_KEY.name: Subject offered key
SUBJECT_KEY.description: Primary key: warehouse key for the subject offering, concatenation of subject code, zero-padded section, and term code, e.g. HAA52430002014JA.

SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY.name: Subject offered summary key
SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Key linking to the SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY table: subject ID + term code, e.g. HAA.52432014JA; unique per row here.

SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.name: Subject summary key
SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Key linking to the SUBJECT_SUMMARY table: subject ID + term code; identical to SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY in this extract.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: Subject title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Title of the course as offered, e.g. 'English 10b:British Writers II', 'Historical Study A-13:China'.

TERM_CODE.name: Term code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term of the offering: 4-digit year plus JA (January/Spring) or SU (Summer), e.g. 2014JA. Joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; '19-DEC-24' for all rows (single load).

table.name: SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY
table.purpose: One row per subject offering (subject + term) at MIT, summarizing enrollment, credit units, offering department/school, cluster (joint/meeting-together) grouping, and responsible faculty. Includes cross-enrolled subjects from Harvard, Wellesley, etc. Key is subject_id + term_code (e.g. HAA.24922014FA).

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Cluster enrollment total
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Total enrollment across all subjects in the cluster (CLUSTER_LIST) this subject belongs to; null when the subject is not in a cluster. 0 may mean no enrollment recorded.

CLUSTER_LIST.name: Cluster subject list
CLUSTER_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs (master subject IDs) that meet together as a cluster; null when not in a cluster.

CLUSTER_TYPE.name: Cluster type code
CLUSTER_TYPE.description: Code for how the subject is grouped: S = school-wide electives, M = meeting together, J = joint subject.

CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.name: Cluster type description
CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of CLUSTER_TYPE: 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', 'Meeting Together', 'Joint subject'.

COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY.name: Composite subject key
COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY.description: Key of the cluster's composite/master subject plus term (e.g. HAA.00002014FA); equals the master subject ID concatenated with the term code. Identifies the umbrella offering the subject rolls up to.

COURSE_NUMBER.name: Course number (subject prefix)
COURSE_NUMBER.description: MIT course/department number that owns the subject (e.g. 14 = Economics, HAA = Harvard cross-enrollment). References SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

HGN_CODE.name: Graduate-level code
HGN_CODE.description: H/G/N code indicating graduate credit level: H = higher level graduate program, G = graduate program, N = not for graduate credit.

LAB_UNITS.name: Lab units
LAB_UNITS.description: Credit units attributed to laboratory work for the subject (MIT units, typically 0-12 per subject).

LECTURE_UNITS.name: Lecture units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Credit units attributed to lecture/recitation for the subject.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Master subject ID
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID of the master/composite subject this offering rolls up to (e.g. HAA.0000 for Harvard school-wide electives; equals SUBJECT_ID when standalone).

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: Master subject ID (sort form)
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: Master subject ID formatted for sorting (padded); same values as MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.

NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.name: Number of enrolled students
NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.description: Enrollment count for this subject offering; identical to SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: Offering department code
OFFER_DEPT_CODE.description: Code of the department offering the subject (e.g. 14 = Economics, NIH = Harvard Cross-Enrollment). References STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE.

OFFER_DEPT_NAME.name: Offering department name
OFFER_DEPT_NAME.description: Name of the offering department (e.g. 'Economics', 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog').

OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.name: Offering school name
OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.description: MIT school of the offering department: Engineering, Science, Hum Arts & Social Sciences, Sloan, Non-MIT (cross-enrollment), etc.

PREPARATION_UNITS.name: Preparation units
PREPARATION_UNITS.description: Credit units attributed to preparation/outside work (the third MIT unit component; lecture + lab + preparation = total units).

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.name: Responsible faculty MIT ID
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.description: MIT ID number of the faculty member responsible for the subject offering; null for most rows (notably cross-enrolled subjects).

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.name: Responsible faculty name
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.description: Name of the responsible faculty member ('Last, First'); null when no faculty assigned.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Subject enrollment number
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Number of students enrolled in this subject offering (0-432).

SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.name: Subject grouping key
SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.description: Opaque surrogate key (hex) identifying the subject grouping/cluster record; likely references SUBJECT_GROUPING.

SUBJECT_ID.name: Subject ID
SUBJECT_ID.description: MIT subject identifier, course number + catalog number (e.g. 14.383, HST.220).

SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: Subject ID (sort form)
SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: SUBJECT_ID padded with leading spaces so numeric course numbers sort correctly.

SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY.name: Subject offering summary key
SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Primary key: SUBJECT_ID concatenated with TERM_CODE (e.g. HAA.24922014FA), uniquely identifying one subject offering in one term.

SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.name: Subject summary key
SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Same value as SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY; duplicate/alternate key column.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: Subject title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Title of the subject as offered (cross-enrolled titles show external catalog names, e.g. 'GOV-1746:Int Conflict &Coopera').

TERM_CODE.name: Term code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term of the offering: 4-digit year + FA (fall), SP (spring), JA (January/IAP), SU (summer). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: Total credit units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total MIT credit units for the subject (lecture + lab + preparation; typically 12).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
