table.name: SUBJECT_SUMMARY
table.purpose: Per-subject, per-term enrollment and credit-unit summary for MIT subjects (including cross-enrolled Harvard subjects), with both the subject's own enrollment and the enrollment of the 'cluster' (group of subjects meeting together, e.g. school-wide electives) it belongs to. One row per subject per academic term.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT.name: Cluster enrollment, first week, for-credit
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT.description: Number of students enrolled for credit in the subject's cluster during the first week of the term. Large values (e.g. 207, 219, 252) reflect aggregated cluster totals shared across all subjects in the cluster.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_1ST_LISTEN.name: Cluster enrollment, first week, listeners
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_1ST_LISTEN.description: Number of listener (non-credit) enrollments in the subject's cluster during the first week of the term. The detected join to SPACE_USAGE is a spurious numeric coincidence, not a real reference.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT.name: Cluster enrollment, fifth week, for-credit
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT.description: Number of for-credit enrollments in the subject's cluster as of the fifth week of the term.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN.name: Cluster enrollment, fifth week, listeners
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN.description: Number of listener (non-credit) enrollments in the subject's cluster as of the fifth week of the term. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.name: Cluster enrollment, for-credit (final)
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.description: For-credit enrollment count for the subject's cluster (final/official figure). Slightly lower than the first/fifth-week figures, consistent with drop-off.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK.name: Cluster total enrollment, fifth week
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK.description: Total enrollment (credit + listener) in the subject's cluster as of the fifth week of the term.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK.name: Cluster total enrollment, first week
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK.description: Total enrollment (credit + listener) in the subject's cluster during the first week of the term.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.name: Cluster enrollment, listeners (final)
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.description: Listener (non-credit) enrollment count for the subject's cluster (final figure). Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Cluster total enrollment (final)
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Total enrollment (credit + listener) for the subject's cluster, final figure. Null when the subject is not part of a cluster.

CLUSTER_LIST.name: Cluster member subject list
CLUSTER_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs belonging to the same meeting-together cluster (truncated with an ellipsis). Null when the subject is not in a cluster.

CLUSTER_TYPE.name: Cluster type code
CLUSTER_TYPE.description: Single-letter code for the cluster type: S = School-Wide Electives, J = Joint subject, M = Meeting Together; blank when no cluster.

CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.name: Cluster type description
CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.description: Human-readable cluster type: 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', 'Joint subject', or 'Meeting Together'.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: Department code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Code of the MIT department offering the subject (e.g. '15' = Management, '1' = Civil and Environmental Eng); 'NIH' denotes the Harvard Cross-Enrollment program. References STUDENT_DEPARTMENT/SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the offering department, e.g. 'Management', 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci', 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog'.

DESIGN_UNITS.name: Design units
DESIGN_UNITS.description: Number of design credit units for the subject (MIT units breakdown); 0 for almost all subjects.

LAB_UNITS.name: Lab units
LAB_UNITS.description: Number of laboratory credit units for the subject (part of MIT's lecture/lab/prep unit breakdown). Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

LECTURE_UNITS.name: Lecture units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Number of lecture credit units for the subject. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Master subject ID
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the master/parent subject (e.g. 'HAA.0000' for the Harvard cross-enrollment umbrella subject) under which this subject is grouped; equals the subject's own ID pattern for regular subjects.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: Master subject ID, sort form
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: Master subject ID formatted for sorting (space-padded numeric portion, e.g. '  2.180').

PREP_UNITS.name: Preparation units
PREP_UNITS.description: Number of preparation/outside-class credit units for the subject. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

SCHOOL_CODE.name: School code
SCHOOL_CODE.description: Code of the MIT school the subject belongs to (E = Engineering, H = Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, S = Science, A = Architecture and Planning, Z = Non-MIT, etc.).

SCHOOL_NAME.name: School name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Name of the school, e.g. 'Engineering', 'Science', 'Non-MIT', 'Schwarzman Coll of Comp'.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT.name: Subject enrollment, first week, for-credit
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT.description: Number of students enrolled for credit in this individual subject during the first week of the term (0 for most Harvard cross-enrollment rows).

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_LISTEN.name: Subject enrollment, first week, listeners
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_LISTEN.description: Number of listener (non-credit) enrollments in this individual subject during the first week. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT.name: Subject enrollment, fifth week, for-credit
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT.description: For-credit enrollment in this individual subject as of the fifth week of the term.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN.name: Subject enrollment, fifth week, listeners
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN.description: Listener (non-credit) enrollment in this individual subject as of the fifth week. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.name: Subject enrollment, for-credit (final)
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.description: Final for-credit enrollment count for this individual subject.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK.name: Subject total enrollment, fifth week
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK.description: Total enrollment (credit + listener) in this individual subject as of the fifth week of the term.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK.name: Subject total enrollment, first week
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK.description: Total enrollment (credit + listener) in this individual subject during the first week of the term.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.name: Subject enrollment, listeners (final)
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.description: Final listener (non-credit) enrollment count for this individual subject. Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Subject total enrollment (final)
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Final total enrollment (credit + listener) for this individual subject.

SUBJECT_GROUP_ID.name: Subject group ID
SUBJECT_GROUP_ID.description: Opaque surrogate key identifying the subject's cluster/group (shared by all subjects meeting together); likely joins to SUBJECT_GROUPING.

SUBJECT_ID.name: Subject ID
SUBJECT_ID.description: MIT subject identifier (course.number format, e.g. '8.18', 'HAA.7468'); Harvard cross-enrolled subjects use H* prefixes.

SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: Subject ID, sort form
SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: Subject ID formatted for correct sorting (space-padded, e.g. '  4.182').

SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER.name: Subject or cluster identifier
SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER.description: The subject's own ID when it stands alone, or the comma-separated cluster subject list when it belongs to a meeting-together cluster.

SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.name: Subject summary key
SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Primary key: concatenation of subject ID and term code (e.g. 'HAA.7468' + '2005FA'), uniquely identifying one subject offering in one term.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: Subject title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Title of the subject as offered (e.g. 'Econ 1402:Central Bankng', 'Undergraduate Research').

TERM_CODE.name: Term code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term of the offering in YYYY+session format (FA = fall, SP = spring, SU = summer, JA = January/IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: Total credit units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total credit units for the subject (sum of lecture/lab/prep/design units; typical MIT values 12, 6, 9, 15). Join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious.

ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Ultimate master subject ID
ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the top-level master subject in the grouping hierarchy (e.g. 'HAA.0000' for all Harvard cross-enrolled subjects).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '20-DEC-24' for this extract.

table.name: TIME_MONTH
table.purpose: A date/time dimension table with one row per fiscal month (fiscal period) from FY1996 through FY2035. Each row maps a calendar month to MIT's July-June fiscal year, academic term/year, and financial aid year, and is keyed by fiscal period (e.g. 200005 = FY2000 Period 5 = November 1999). Includes closing periods (periods 13-16) that share calendar months with regular periods. Referenced by facility history and fiscal period tables as their time key.

ACADEMIC_TERM.name: academic_term_code
ACADEMIC_TERM.description: Term code (e.g. 2000FA, 2022SP, 2016SU, 2001JA) for the academic term the month falls in; FA=Fall, SP=Spring, SU=Summer, JA=January (IAP). Null when the month falls outside any academic term. References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: academic_term_description
ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable form of ACADEMIC_TERM, e.g. 'Fall Term 1999-2000', 'January Term 2008-2009'. Null rate matches ACADEMIC_TERM.

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: academic_year
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Ending calendar year of the academic year the month belongs to (e.g. 2000 for Fall Term 1999-2000). Null when month is not in an academic term.

CALENDAR_MONTH.name: calendar_month_number
CALENDAR_MONTH.description: Calendar month number 1-12 of the row's calendar month. The join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is spurious (numeric coincidence), not a real relationship.

CALENDAR_PERIOD.name: calendar_period_code
CALENDAR_PERIOD.description: Unique code for the calendar month, YYYYMM (e.g. 199911); closing periods get a suffix, e.g. 202806P16 for June 2028 fiscal period 16. Unique across all 640 rows.

CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION.name: calendar_period_description
CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable calendar period, e.g. 'November 1999' or 'June 2028, fiscal period 16' for closing periods.

CALENDAR_YEAR.name: calendar_year
CALENDAR_YEAR.description: Calendar year (1995-2035) of the row's month.

END_DATE.name: period_end_date
END_DATE.description: Last calendar date of the month in DD-MON-YY form (e.g. 30-NOV-99, 28-FEB-22).

FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.name: financial_aid_year
FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.description: Starting year of the federal financial aid award year the month falls in (aid year runs roughly July-June, e.g. 2000 = Aid Year 1999-2000). Null for months outside the aid year (e.g. June/July of some years).

FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR_DESC.name: financial_aid_year_description
FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR_DESC.description: Human-readable aid year, e.g. 'Aid Year 1999-2000'. Nulls match FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.

FISCAL_PERIOD.name: fiscal_period_code
FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Fiscal period key, YYYYNN where YYYY is the fiscal year (ending) and NN the period 1-16 (July=1 ... June=12, plus closing periods 13-16). E.g. 200005 = FY2000 Period 5 = November 1999. Referenced by FCLT history tables and FRC_FISCAL_PERIODS.

FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION.name: fiscal_period_description
FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable fiscal period, e.g. 'FY 2000 Period 5' or 'FY 2028 closing period 4'.

FISCAL_PERIOD_SELECTOR.name: fiscal_period_selector
FISCAL_PERIOD_SELECTOR.description: Display/selector string combining code and label, e.g. '200005 -- November 1999', '201215 -- June 2012 Closing'.

FISCAL_YEAR.name: fiscal_year
FISCAL_YEAR.description: Fiscal year (1996-2035) the month belongs to; MIT fiscal year runs July-June, so FY2000 covers Jul 1999-Jun 2000.

FISCAL_YEAR_QUARTER.name: fiscal_year_quarter_name
FISCAL_YEAR_QUARTER.description: Fiscal quarter label, e.g. 'FY 2000 Quarter 2'; references TIME_QUARTER.FY_QUARTER_NAME.

FY_QUARTER_CODE.name: fiscal_quarter_code
FY_QUARTER_CODE.description: Compact fiscal quarter code, e.g. FY2000Q2; references TIME_QUARTER.FY_QUARTER_CODE.

IS_CLOSING_PERIOD.name: is_closing_period
IS_CLOSING_PERIOD.description: Y/N flag: Y for the year-end closing periods (13-16, mapped to June), N for the 12 regular monthly periods.

IS_CURRENT_FISCAL_PERIOD.name: is_current_fiscal_period
IS_CURRENT_FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Y/N flag marking the single row that is the current fiscal period at the time the table was loaded.

IS_CURRENT_FISCAL_YEAR.name: is_current_fiscal_year
IS_CURRENT_FISCAL_YEAR.description: Y/N flag marking the 16 rows of the current fiscal year at load time.

IS_PREVIOUS_FISCAL_PERIOD.name: is_previous_fiscal_period
IS_PREVIOUS_FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Y/N flag marking the single row that is the immediately preceding fiscal period at load time.

START_DATE.name: period_start_date
START_DATE.description: First calendar date of the month in DD-MON-YY form (e.g. 01-NOV-99).

TIME_MONTH_KEY.name: time_month_key
TIME_MONTH_KEY.description: Primary key of the table (surrogate = fiscal period code YYYYNN, e.g. 200005). Referenced by FRC_FISCAL_PERIODS and the FCLT history tables' FISCAL_PERIOD columns.

table.name: TIME_QUARTER
table.purpose: Time dimension table of fiscal and calendar quarters (one row per quarter, FY2000 Q1 through FY2035 Q4, 144 rows). MIT's fiscal year runs July 1 - June 30, so fiscal quarters map to calendar quarters offset by two quarters (FY Q1 = Jul-Sep). Also carries payroll/effort-certification (ED/ACCA) quarterly schedule dates. Referenced by TIME_MONTH, which rolls months up to quarters.

CALENDAR_YEAR.name: calendar_year
CALENDAR_YEAR.description: Calendar year (Gregorian) in which the quarter falls, e.g. 2003 for CY2003Q4.

CY_QUARTER_CODE.name: calendar_quarter_code
CY_QUARTER_CODE.description: Unique code for the calendar quarter, format CY<year>Q<1-4>, e.g. CY2003Q4.

CY_QUARTER_NAME.name: calendar_quarter_name
CY_QUARTER_NAME.description: Human-readable calendar quarter label, e.g. 'CY 2003 Quarter 4'.

FISCAL_YEAR.name: fiscal_year
FISCAL_YEAR.description: Fiscal year (July-June) the quarter belongs to; for Oct-Dec 2003 the fiscal year is 2004.

FY_QUARTER_CODE.name: fiscal_quarter_code
FY_QUARTER_CODE.description: Primary key. Unique fiscal quarter code, format FY<year>Q<1-4>; FY Q1 = Jul-Sep. Referenced by TIME_MONTH.FY_QUARTER_CODE.

FY_QUARTER_NAME.name: fiscal_quarter_name
FY_QUARTER_NAME.description: Human-readable fiscal quarter label, e.g. 'FY 2004 Quarter 2'. Referenced by TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_YEAR_QUARTER.

IS_CURRENT_QUARTER.name: is_current_quarter
IS_CURRENT_QUARTER.description: Y/N flag: whether this quarter is the current quarter as of the warehouse load (20-DEC-24); exactly one row is Y.

IS_FUTURE_QUARTER.name: is_future_quarter
IS_FUTURE_QUARTER.description: Y/N flag: whether the quarter is after the current quarter (as of load date).

IS_NEXT_QUARTER.name: is_next_quarter
IS_NEXT_QUARTER.description: Y/N flag: whether this quarter is the quarter immediately following the current one; all N at this load, so the flag is currently inactive.

IS_PAST_QUARTER.name: is_past_quarter
IS_PAST_QUARTER.description: Y/N flag: whether the quarter precedes the current quarter (as of load date).

IS_PREVIOUS_QUARTER.name: is_previous_quarter
IS_PREVIOUS_QUARTER.description: Y/N flag: whether this quarter is the quarter immediately before the current one; all N at this load, so the flag is currently inactive.

PAYROLL_EDACCA_CERT_SCHED_KEY.name: payroll_edacca_cert_schedule_key
PAYROLL_EDACCA_CERT_SCHED_KEY.description: Key for the payroll effort-certification (ED/ACCA) quarterly schedule, format <fiscal_year><quarter_number>, e.g. 200402 for FY2004 Q2.

QUARTER_CERT_DUE.name: quarter_cert_due_date
QUARTER_CERT_DUE.description: Date the effort certification report for the quarter is due, DD-MON-YY; typically the last day of the month two months after quarter end (e.g. 31-MAR-04 for quarter ending 31-DEC-03).

QUARTER_CERT_EXPECTED.name: quarter_cert_expected_date
QUARTER_CERT_EXPECTED.description: Date the effort certification is expected, DD-MON-YY; typically the last day of the month one month after quarter end (e.g. 29-FEB-04 for quarter ending 31-DEC-03).

QUARTER_CERT_OPEN.name: quarter_cert_open_date
QUARTER_CERT_OPEN.description: Date the effort certification period opens, DD-MON-YY; equals the quarter start date (e.g. 01-JAN-04).

QUARTER_END_DATE.name: quarter_end_date
QUARTER_END_DATE.description: Last calendar date of the quarter, DD-MON-YY (e.g. 31-DEC-03).

QUARTER_END_FP.name: quarter_end_fiscal_period
QUARTER_END_FP.description: Fiscal period (YYYYMM) of the last month of the quarter, e.g. 200406 for quarter ending Dec 2003 (fiscal period June 2004). Matches TIME_MONTH fiscal period keys.

QUARTER_START_DATE.name: quarter_start_date
QUARTER_START_DATE.description: First calendar date of the quarter, DD-MON-YY (e.g. 01-OCT-03).

QUARTER_START_FP.name: quarter_start_fiscal_period
QUARTER_START_FP.description: Fiscal period (YYYYMM) of the first month of the quarter, e.g. 200404 for quarter starting Oct 2003 (fiscal period April 2004). Matches TIME_MONTH fiscal period keys.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the table was loaded/refreshed into the warehouse; constant 20-DEC-24 for all rows.

table.name: TIP_DETAIL
table.purpose: Textbook/course-material detail per subject offering per term: one row per course material record (or 'no materials' record) for a subject-term, with ISBN, material status, and warehouse keys. TIP likely = Textbook Information Program (course material adoption data).

ISBN.name: ISBN
ISBN.description: ISBN of the course material (mostly ISBN-13, some ISBN-10 stored as digits). Null when the course has no materials or the material has no ISBN; '0'/'0 ' used as placeholder. Not a reliable numeric field.

RECORD_COUNT.name: RECORD_COUNT
RECORD_COUNT.description: Constant 1 in every row; a row-count/ETL flag, not meaningful data.

SUBJECT_ID.name: SUBJECT_ID
SUBJECT_ID.description: MIT subject (course) number, e.g. 21L.003, 14.781. Values like CANC.BARCHARTS / CANC.SPO appear to be cancelled or special (non-standard) subject identifiers.

TERM_CODE.name: TERM_CODE
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code (e.g. 2013SP, 2016SU, 2024JA where JA = IAP/January). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

TIP_MATERIAL_KEY.name: TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
TIP_MATERIAL_KEY.description: Composite warehouse key for the material record: ISBN + material title + edition(?) + term code; for no-materials rows it is 'N/A' + 'Course has no materials' + term code. Likely joins to TIP_MATERIAL.

TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.name: TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.description: Code for the material adoption status; references TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS. Known codes: RQ (required, most common), NM (course has no materials), EO/RC (likely 'optional'/'recommended' variants), BR (bookstore recommends), CL (go to class first), U (unknown), NL (null label).

TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.name: TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.description: Composite key for the subject offering: zero-padded subject number + section(?) + term code (e.g. 0173910002016FA = 17.391, 000, 2016FA). Likely joins to TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant 20-DEC-24 for this extract.

table.name: TIP_MATERIAL
table.purpose: Textbook/course material catalog for the TIP (Textbook Information Program) system: one row per required material (mostly books) per term, with bibliographic data and new/used/rental prices. The key embeds ISBN + title + edition + year + term (e.g. 2021SP/2021FA), and TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS / TIP_DETAIL / TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED are related tables. Prices appear to be in whole US dollars (MIT Coop textbook pricing).

AUTHOR.name: AUTHOR
AUTHOR.description: Author(s) of the material, typically in 'Last, First' form, multiple authors separated by semicolons. Placeholder values like 'NOT FOUND on ISBN.org' and 'Unknown' occur when the author could not be determined.

EDITION.name: EDITION
EDITION.description: Edition of the book, usually a number ('2', '3') but sometimes with a year suffix ('2nd 98', '2nd 97'). Blank/space values and nulls are common; some values like '40', '70' look like data-entry noise rather than true editions.

ISBN.name: ISBN
ISBN.description: ISBN (mostly 13-digit, ISBN-13) of the material. 0 or blank indicates no/unknown ISBN (e.g. course packets, custom materials). Not unique because the same book can appear for multiple terms.

MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE.name: MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE
MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE.description: Code for where the material's metadata came from: 'ISBN' (looked up from ISBN.org), 'COOP' (MIT Coop bookstore), 'OTI' (another source, likely an online textbook retailer such as 'OnTheInternet'/OTI feed). Exact expansion of OTI is not certain.

NEW_SHELF_PRICE.name: NEW_SHELF_PRICE
NEW_SHELF_PRICE.description: Shelf (retail) price in whole US dollars for a new copy of the material. 0 or null when not stocked/priced.

PUBLISHER.name: PUBLISHER
PUBLISHER.description: Publisher of the material. Some values are abbreviated codes ('Vst', 'Dgtl Bncom' = digital/B&N, 'Yuzu' = digital platform), others are full publisher names or even publication statements ('New York, Wiley [1975]') copied from catalog records.

RENTAL_NEW_PRICE.name: RENTAL_NEW_PRICE
RENTAL_NEW_PRICE.description: Rental price in whole US dollars for a new copy; 0 (92% of rows) means rental is not offered for that material.

RENTAL_USED_PRICE.name: RENTAL_USED_PRICE
RENTAL_USED_PRICE.description: Rental price in whole US dollars for a used copy; 0 (92% of rows) means rental is not offered for that material.

TIP_MATERIAL_KEY.name: TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
TIP_MATERIAL_KEY.description: Primary key: a concatenation of ISBN + abbreviated title + edition + publication year + term code (e.g. '142021SP' = 2021 spring, '132013FA' = 2013 fall), uniquely identifying a material offered in a specific term.

TITLE.name: TITLE
TITLE.description: Title of the material; 'Ebk ' prefix indicates an e-book. Padded with trailing spaces in some rows.

USED_SHELF_PRICE.name: USED_SHELF_PRICE
USED_SHELF_PRICE.description: Shelf (retail) price in whole US dollars for a used copy; 0 or null when no used copies are stocked/priced.

YEAR.name: YEAR
YEAR.description: Publication/copyright year of the material (range roughly 1960-2024; 0 = unknown).

table.name: TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
table.purpose: Lookup table of material status codes for TIP (Textbook/Training Instructional Program?) course materials, describing how course materials relate to a class (required, recommended, no materials, etc.). Referenced by TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY. 12 rows, one per status code plus blank/unknown entries.

TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS.name: material_status_description
TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS.description: Human-readable description of the material status code, e.g. 'Required', 'Recommended', 'Bookstore recommends', 'Course has no materials', 'Go to class first', 'Val-u option', 'Electronic options', 'Unknown'. Null for some codes (e.g. 'NL'), meaning no description available.

TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE.name: material_status_code
TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE.description: Two-letter code for the material status; duplicates TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY in all observed rows (e.g. NM, BR, CL, EO, NB, NL, RC, RQ, blank).

TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.name: material_status_key
TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.description: Primary key of the lookup table; the two-letter status code used by TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY to join. Includes a blank/'  ' value (likely 'not applicable/unknown').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format ('20-DEC-24'); same for all rows, so an ETL load timestamp rather than business data.

table.name: TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: One row per subject offering per academic term at MIT: the subject (course number and number), the offering department and school, responsible faculty member, and enrollment count. Appears to be a warehouse fact table (TIP = Teaching Information/Insight Program) keyed by subject + term. Spans terms from at least 1995 to 2025 (FA/SP/SU/JA = fall/spring/summer/January IAP).

COURSE_NUMBER.name: course_number
COURSE_NUMBER.description: MIT course (department) number code, e.g. 15 = Management, 6 = EECS, 21M = Music and Theater Arts. References SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: course_number_description
COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Human-readable name of the course/department corresponding to COURSE_NUMBER (e.g. 15 -> 'Management').

COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.name: course_number_sort_key
COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.description: Zero/space-padded version of COURSE_NUMBER used for correct lexicographic sorting (e.g. '  4', ' 15', '21F').

IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL.name: no_course_material_flag
IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the subject offering has no course material (e.g. no syllabus/reserve material). Null for most rows (~79%), likely meaning unknown/not applicable.

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.name: master_course_number
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.description: Course number of the master/parent subject (the subject this offering is cataloged under); usually equals COURSE_NUMBER but can differ (e.g. cross-listed subjects).

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: master_course_number_description
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Human-readable name of the master course number's department.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Full master subject identifier (course number + subject number, e.g. '2.EPE', '15.792'); the parent subject of this offering.

NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.name: enrolled_student_count
NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.description: Number of students enrolled in this subject offering for the term (0-648, median 5).

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: offering_department_code
OFFER_DEPT_CODE.description: Code of the department actually offering the subject this term; usually same as COURSE_NUMBER but can differ (e.g. 21M subject offered by 'Music' dept code 21M while course desc differs).

OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.name: offering_school_name
OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.description: MIT school the offering department belongs to (Engineering, Science, Hum Arts & Social Sciences, Architecture and Planning, Sloan, etc.).

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.name: responsible_faculty_mit_id
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.description: MIT ID number of the faculty member responsible for the subject offering; null for ~17% of rows (no assigned instructor of record).

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.name: responsible_faculty_name
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.description: Name (Last, First) of the responsible faculty member, matching RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: Full subject identifier of this offering (e.g. '21M.835', '15.220'); differs from MASTER_SUBJECT_ID for cross-listed/equivalent subjects.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: subject_title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Title of the subject offering (e.g. 'International Management', 'Undergraduate Research').

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code, YYYY + session (FA fall, SP spring, SU summer, JA January/IAP), e.g. 2019FA. References ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.name: tip_subject_offered_key
TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.description: Primary key: concatenation of subject id (zero-padded) and term code, e.g. '21M8350002002FA' = subject 21M.835 in 2002FA.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '20-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN
table.purpose: Lookup table of internet top-level domains (mostly ISO country codes) with their descriptions (country or organization names), used to decode TLD codes appearing elsewhere in the warehouse. Loaded once in June 1999.

TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN.name: Top-level domain code
TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN.description: The internet top-level domain code, primarily two-letter ISO 3166 country codes (HU, KG, SB, DM, PE, YE, MV) plus special/legacy TLDs such as ARPA and a numeric value '99'. One row per TLD.

TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_DESCRIPTION.name: Top-level domain description
TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable meaning of the TLD code: country name (Hungary, Kyrgyzstan, Solomon Islands, Switzerland) or organization name (Advanced Projects Research Agency for ARPA).

TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_KEY.name: Top-level domain key
TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN_KEY.description: Duplicate of TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN; identical values in every sample. Likely serves as the join key to other tables while TOP_LEVEL_DOMAIN is the display value, though no joins were detected.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format. Nearly all rows loaded 17-JUN-99, one on 21-JUN-99.

table.name: WAREHOUSE_USERS
table.purpose: Directory of MIT warehouse users: one row per person (employee or student) with their MIT ID, Kerberos username, name, email, office location/phone, and home organizational unit. Appears to be a data-warehouse copy of the MIT person/employee directory (cf. EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY, DRUPAL_EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY).

APPOINTMENT_TYPE.name: appointment_type
APPOINTMENT_TYPE.description: Type of appointment; only value is 'Primary Appointment', indicating the row reflects the person's primary appointment.

EMAIL_ADDRESS.name: email_address
EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Person's email address (synthetic/masked domains like worker.com, employee.com). Not unique; roughly 0.665 unique per row.

KRB_NAME.name: kerberos_username
KRB_NAME.description: MIT Kerberos/Athena username (lowercase), typically firstname + last initial.

KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE.name: kerberos_username_uppercase
KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE.description: Same Kerberos username in uppercase; some values include a numeric suffix (e.g. CHADN7), likely to disambiguate duplicates.

MIDDLE_NAME.name: middle_name
MIDDLE_NAME.description: Person's middle name or middle initial; null for about half the rows.

MIT_ID.name: mit_id
MIT_ID.description: MIT personal identifier (9-digit number starting with 9); unique, primary key of the table.

OFFICE_LOCATION.name: office_location
OFFICE_LOCATION.description: Office location in MIT building-room format (e.g. E53-355, 5-172F, NE49); building number optionally followed by room. Null for ~11%.

OFFICE_PHONE.name: office_phone
OFFICE_PHONE.description: Office phone number stored as digits (area code + number, e.g. 617/253-style values); null for ~17%. Values appear masked/synthetic.

UNIT_ID.name: unit_id
UNIT_ID.description: Identifier of the person's organizational unit (MIT DLC), 6-digit zero-padded code; pairs with UNIT_NAME (e.g. 310000 = Lincoln Laboratory).

UNIT_NAME.name: unit_name
UNIT_NAME.description: Name of the person's organizational unit (department, lab, or center), e.g. 'Lincoln Laboratory', 'Mechanical Engineering'.

YEAR.description: Almost entirely null; only values 'G' (20) and '1' (3). Possibly a student class year ('G' = graduate, '1' = freshman), but with 23 non-null values matching the STUDENT count this is plausible yet unconfirmed.

table.name: ZIP_CANADA
table.purpose: Canadian postal code lookup table; this extract contains only Newfoundland and Labrador (NL) postal codes mapped to city names. Companion to ZIP_USA. Used for address validation/standardization in the warehouse.

CITY_NAME.name: city_name
CITY_NAME.description: Name of the Canadian city/community served by the postal code (e.g., St. John's, Corner Brook).

CITY_TYPE.name: city_type
CITY_TYPE.description: Code distinguishing the type of locality; 'D' (99.9%) likely 'default'/'standard' city name for the postal code and 'A' (13 rows) likely an alternate/alias city name. Exact code meanings are not documented; the D/A split is the only evidence.

POSTAL_CODE.name: postal_code
POSTAL_CODE.description: Canadian postal code (format A1A 1A1), the primary key of the table; nearly unique per row.

PROVINCE_ABBR.name: province_abbr
PROVINCE_ABBR.description: Two-letter Canadian province/territory abbreviation; all rows are 'NL' (Newfoundland and Labrador).

PROVINCE_NAME.name: province_name
PROVINCE_NAME.description: Full province name; all rows are 'Newfoundland' (the table predates or uses the short form of Newfoundland and Labrador).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (25-MAY-23 for all rows).

table.name: ZIP_USA
table.purpose: US postal ZIP code reference table (city, county, state per ZIP), apparently limited to the northeastern US, Puerto Rico, and military/APO-FPO ZIPs. Loaded into the data warehouse on 25-MAY-23. Note ZIP_CODE appears to be stored numerically, stripping leading zeros (e.g. 715 = 00715 Ponce PR).

CITY_NAME.name: city_name
CITY_NAME.description: Name of the city/postal community served by the ZIP code. Includes USPS special entries such as APO/DPO/FPO (military post offices) and urbanization names in Puerto Rico (e.g. 'Urb Monte Brisas 2').

CITY_TYPE.name: city_type
CITY_TYPE.description: USPS city-name classification code. Values: D (default/primary city name for the ZIP), A (alternate/alias city name), N (not-acceptable city name, e.g. urbanizations and non-preferred names). The joins to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE are spurious statistical coincidences, not real relationships.

COUNTY_NAME.name: county_name
COUNTY_NAME.description: County (or PR municipio) name for the ZIP code; 'none' where no county is assigned (e.g. military/APO-FPO ZIPs).

STATE_ABBR.name: state_abbr
STATE_ABBR.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory abbreviation (PR, NJ, MA, ME, VT, RI, NY, VI, AE = Armed Forces Europe, etc.).

STATE_NAME.name: state_name
STATE_NAME.description: Full name of the state or territory corresponding to STATE_ABBR.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '25-MAY-23' for all rows in this snapshot.

ZIP_CODE.name: zip_code
ZIP_CODE.description: US 5-digit ZIP code, stored as a number so leading zeros are lost (e.g. 715 = 00715, 926 = 00926 San Juan PR). Not a primary key here since a ZIP can appear with multiple city/county rows.

ZIP_TYPE.name: zip_type
ZIP_TYPE.description: USPS ZIP code classification: S = standard, P = PO Box only, M = military, U = unique (single high-volume recipient).

table.name: ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD
table.purpose: Room-level space inventory load table: one row per MIT room, giving its building, floor, room number, space usage classification, owning organizational unit, and access level. Appears to be a staging/load table (ZPM prefix) feeding or derived from the space/facilities data (FCLT_ROOMS, SPACE_* tables).

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: access_level
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Coded access/security level of the room, values 0-3. Exact meaning of each level is not documented here; the scale (0=lowest to 3=highest restriction) is plausible but unverified.

BUILDING_COMPONENT.name: building_number
BUILDING_COMPONENT.description: Building number identifying the building that contains the room; references FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING.BUILDING_NUMBER. Values like '32', '13', '42T' match MIT building numbers.

BUILDING_ROOM.name: building_room
BUILDING_ROOM.description: Full room identifier in 'building-room' format (e.g. '10-409' = building 10, room 409). Nearly unique per row; combined with building it identifies the room.

FLOOR.name: floor
FLOOR.description: Floor of the building the room is on; numeric floors ('0'-'27') plus basement/sublevel codes like 'D6', 'G6' (deck/ground levels). References SPACE_FLOOR.

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: hr_org_unit_id
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: Identifier of the HR organizational unit responsible for/occupying the room; references HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.

SPACE_UNIT_CODE.name: space_unit_code
SPACE_UNIT_CODE.description: Code of the space/occupancy unit (departmental space assignment) that owns or occupies the room; references SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE. Correlates 1:1 with HR_ORG_UNIT_ID in this data.

SPACE_USAGE.name: space_usage
SPACE_USAGE.description: Room use classification code, e.g. 'STF ROOM' (staff room), 'RESEARCH CENTER', 'IT HLPDSK' (IT help desk), 'SLS OFFICE', 'FIL RM' (file room), 'TRNG RM' (training room), 'RSRC RM' (resource room), 'VISITOR CTR'.
